item.g:description: Kitty Litter Scoop Nobody loves litter duty. But with the right scoop, it takes thirty seconds, stays mess-free, and doesn't feel like a chore you're dreading. The Paletta Kitty Litter Scoop is designed to make the least glamorous part of cat ownership as quick, clean, and painless as possible — a sturdy, well-balanced scoop that sifts efficiently, handles comfortably, and looks good enough to leave out without embarrassment. Available in Pink, Grey, and Blue, it's the litter accessory that quietly makes your life better every single day. Why the Kitty Litter Scoop Is the Best Choice Efficient sifting design — slots sized to separate clumps cleanly while letting clean litter fall through Sturdy, durable construction — built to handle daily use without bending, cracking, or breaking Ergonomic handle — comfortable grip that makes scooping quick and strain-free Deep scoop head — picks up clumps cleanly in fewer passes, reducing mess and contact Available in 3 colors — Pink, Grey, Blue — match your litter box setup or your personal style By Paletta — purpose-built litter accessories designed for real daily use Product Details & Features A litter scoop sounds simple — and the best ones are. The Paletta Kitty Litter Scoop is designed with the right proportions: a scoop head deep enough to pick up clumps without them rolling off, slots wide enough to let clean litter fall through efficiently, and a handle long enough to keep your hand well clear of the litter box. The result is a tool that does its job quickly, cleanly, and without fuss — every single time. The durable construction means this scoop won't flex or snap under the pressure of compacted clumps, and the smooth finish makes it easy to rinse clean after use. Three color options mean you can coordinate with your litter box or simply pick the color that makes even litter duty feel a little more personal.

item.g:title: Virbac Kidney Support Dog Food K1 – For Dogs with Kidney Disease 3KG
item.g:description: VETERINARY HPM® K1 Kidney Support is a complete and balanced dry food for dogs with temporary or chronic kidney disease. It’s expertly formulated to support your dog’s kidney function while helping them to maintain optimal body condition. Ideal nutrient ratios for dogs with kidney disease VETERINARY HPM® K1 Kidney Support contains a restricted amount of high-quality proteins (20.5%) to preserve lean muscle mass without adding additional strain on the kidneys. This is balanced with high energy density to give your dog the energy they need from smaller portions – ideal for periods of appetite loss. Low in phosphorous to preserve kidney function Phosphorus is an essential mineral, but in dogs with compromised kidney health they are not able to filter it effectively. VETERINARY HPM® K1 Kidney Support contains low levels of phosphorus (0.4%) to protect your dog’s kidney function. It also features chitosan, an ingredient that binds to phosphorus and reduces levels in the body. Reduces the risk of secondary health issues VETERINARY HPM® K1 Kidney Support helps to limit the risk of other health conditions associated with kidney disease. It contains: • Balanced calcium and phosphorus to protect against secondary hyperparathyroidism. • Adapted protein level to reduce production of uraemic toxins whilst maintaining body condition. • Calcium carbonate to help limit the risk of metabolic acidosis. Supportive nutrients for overall health and wellbeing VETERINARY HPM® K1 Kidney Support features a blend of ingredients designed to support your dog’s overall wellbeing: • Vitamin E is an antioxidant that helps to limit oxidative stress on the kidneys and other organs. • Omega-3 fatty acids support skin and coat health and help to limit inflammation. • Chondroitin sulphate helps to support joint cartilage health. • Chitosan optimises the breakdown and absorption of chondroitin. VETERINARY HPM® K1 Kidney Support is an ideal dog food for kidney disease in both adult and senior dogs, and is also suitable for dogs with chronic hepatic (liver) disease. Rich in naturally tasty, high-quality animal ingredients to help with palatability.

item.g:description: INABA Churu Tuna with Scallop Recipe x4 pcs INGREDIENTS: Water, Tuna, Tapioca Starch, Scallop, Natural Scallop Flavor, Natural Flavors, Guar Gum, Vitamin E Supplement, Taurine, Green Tea Extract GUARANTEED ANALYSIS: Crude Protein(min) 7.00% Crude Fat (min) 0.20% Crude Fiber (max) 0.30% Moisture (max) 91.00% Vitamin E (min) 310 IU/kg Taurine (min) 0.025% CALORIE CONTENT: 430kcal/kg, 6.0kcal/tube ME Here at Inaba, we know your cat is a beloved family member. That’s why each of our Churu Lickable Creamy Purée Natural Cat Treats is made from high-quality ingredients, including wild-caught tuna and farm-raised chicken. Since cats are not naturally drawn to water, we have made these a high-moisture, low-calorie cat treat that your kitties will love. They contain 91% moisture and have only six calories per tube. That’s a tenth of the calories of traditional dry cat treats and more than 1000 times the moisture (8% vs. 91% moisture). In addition, we’ve also added Taurine to help with their vision, digestion, and heart health, as well as Vitamin E for immunity and Green Tea Extract for its natural antioxidants. What they’re missing? They’re grain-free, preservative-free, carrageenan-free, and free from artificial colors, making them a cat treat you can feel good about feeding. Designed to be hand fed, you can use it to help calm the feistiest of outdoor ferals or treat your pampered indoor pussycat. They can be used as a dry/canned cat food topper or to assist with giving medications. Available in 19 savory flavors, you’ll be able to find a flavor that your kitty will crave no matter what stage of life they are (kitten to senior). Inaba Churu makes snack time fun for you and your feline friends. MADE WITH WHOLESOME INGREDIENTS YOU CAN TRUST : Every Inaba product is made with yummy high-quality ingredients, including farm-raised chicken and/or natural wild-caught tuna KEEP YOUR FELINE HYDRATED WITHOUT ADDING CALORIES: Each delicious, creamy Churu tube contains 91% moisture and only six calories (a tenth of the calories of traditional dry cat treats), which makes it a healthy snack you can feel good about feeding FREE OF THE BAD STUFF : Your feline friend is important to us, which is why we’ve kept things like grains, preservatives, artificial colors, and carrageenan out of our cat treats, but we added things like Taurine to help with their overall health HAVE THEM EATING OUT OF YOUR HAND : These lickable purée meat tubes for cats were designed to be fed by hand as an interactive way to spend time with your feline, but you can use them as a wet/dry cat food topper or as a way to disguise medication ADD SOME VARIETY TO YOUR CAT’S LIFE : Available in nineteen savory flavors, cats of all stages (kitten to senior) will be able to find a flavor they love Feeding Instructions Feed as a treat to your cat. This product is not intended to be fed as a meal. Provide clean, fresh water daily. For your pet’s health, see your veterinarian regularly. Storage Instructions Refrigerate after opening and serve as soon as possible.

item.g:title: NexGard for Dogs 25-50kg One Chewable tablet
item.g:description: NexGard for Dogs 25–50 kg NexGard is a widely trusted monthly flea and tick chewable for dogs, approved by veterinarians worldwide and loved by dogs for its beef-flavored taste. Designed for dogs weighing 25 to 50 kg, NexGard delivers fast, effective protection against fleas and ticks with the convenience of a once-monthly oral treatment. The active ingredient, afoxolaner, works through a dog's bloodstream to target and kill fleas and ticks when they bite. NexGard starts killing fleas within 8 hours and ticks within 48 hours of administration, significantly reducing the risk of tick-borne diseases such as ehrlichiosis and babesiosis. Unlike topical treatments, NexGard cannot be washed or rubbed off, making it a reliable choice for dogs that swim, bathe frequently, or live active outdoor lifestyles. Product Features Formulated for dogs weighing 25 to 50 kg Monthly chewable for continuous flea and tick control Starts killing fleas within 8 hours and ticks within 48 hours Beef-flavored chewable, accepted easily by most dogs Effective against Ixodes, Rhipicephalus, and Amblyomma tick species Kills fleas before they can lay eggs, interrupting the flea life cycle Not affected by bathing, swimming, or rain Approved and recommended by veterinarians Active Ingredient Afoxolaner – a systemic isoxazoline compound that inhibits the nervous system of fleas and ticks. Dosing Guide Dog Weight Tablet Variant Dosing Interval 25 - 50 kg Nexgard 136 mg Every 30 days Administer monthly. Can be given with or without food. Not recommended for puppies under 8 weeks of age or weighing less than 2 kg. Consult a veterinarian before use in dogs with a history of seizures. item.g:title: Evatri for dogs 1 TABLET
item.g:description: Evatri for Dogs – 1 Tablet Evatri is a reliable deworming tablet for dogs that provides effective treatment against the most common intestinal parasites. Available as a single tablet, it is a practical and affordable solution for dog owners who want to keep their dog's intestinal health in check without the cost of large multi-pack purchases. Intestinal worms are one of the most common health concerns for dogs in Egypt, where warm temperatures support year-round parasite activity. Regular deworming with a trusted product like Evatri helps prevent worm burdens from building up, protecting both your dog's health and, in the case of some parasites, your family's wellbeing as well. Evatri is especially popular among owners who maintain a consistent monthly or quarterly deworming schedule and prefer to purchase tablets individually for flexibility. Product Features Effective deworming tablet for adult dogs Treats common intestinal worms including roundworms and tapeworms Single tablet format for easy dosing and flexible purchasing Convenient and affordable option for regular deworming routines Suitable for dogs as part of a routine parasite control program Easy to administer, can be hidden in food Available individually at Zima Pets Dosing Guide Dosing is based on the dog's body weight. Refer to the product packaging for exact weight-based dosing instructions, or consult your veterinarian for personalized guidance. Administration Frequency Notes With or without food Every 1-3 months Follow label dosing by weight For best results, weigh your dog before administering to ensure the correct dose. Consult a veterinarian before deworming puppies under 6 weeks of age, pregnant dogs, or dogs with known health conditions. Regular deworming is especially important in multi-pet households and for dogs with outdoor access. item.g:title: IMac Dea Food Dispenser for Pet Red / 3L (33.5*24*29.5 Cm)
item.g:description: IMac Dea Food Dispenser for Pets The feeding station that works while you don't. The IMac Dea Food Dispenser brings the clean, considered design of the Dea range to a fully functional gravity-fed dispenser — a reservoir unit that automatically releases food into the bowl as your pet eats, keeping the feeding station consistently stocked without constant manual refilling. Available in Blue and Red, in 1.5L and 3L capacities, the Dea Dispenser is the practical, beautiful solution for busy households, free-feeding routines, and owners who want the confidence that their pet always has food available — in a unit that looks as intentional as everything else in their home. Why IMac Dea Food Dispenser Is the Best Choice Gravity-fed auto-refill mechanism — as your pet eats from the bowl, food flows down from the reservoir automatically, maintaining a consistent level without any manual intervention between fills Italian Dea design language — the same clean, rounded aesthetic that defines the Dea range, now in a full dispenser format; functional and beautiful in equal measure Available in Blue and Red — two bold color options to suit your home's aesthetic or to differentiate dispensers in multi-pet households 1.5L and 3L reservoir capacities — the 1.5L suits cats and small dogs with 1–2 days of food between fills; the 3L handles larger dogs or multi-day free-feeding routines No batteries or electronics — the gravity mechanism is passive, reliable, and maintenance-free; nothing to charge, replace, or repair Transparent reservoir section — allows easy visual monitoring of food levels without opening or moving the unit Stable, wide-base design — the dispenser's footprint and low center of gravity keep it stable even during enthusiastic feeding Suitable for both cats and dogs — the dispenser format works across species and feeding styles Product Details & Features The Dea Food Dispenser operates on the same reliable gravity principle as the Ciottoli Dispenser — food stored in an upper reservoir flows down by gravity into the bowl below as the bowl empties. The mechanism is entirely passive: no batteries, no electronics, no moving parts. It works continuously and silently, requiring attention only when the reservoir needs refilling. What distinguishes the Dea Dispenser from the Ciottoli Dispenser is the design language. Where the Ciottoli range is defined by its smooth, pebble-inspired rounded form, the Dea range has its own distinct aesthetic identity — and the Dea Dispenser maintains that identity in a full-height dispenser format. The result is a feeding station that integrates naturally into a home environment as a considered design object rather than a purely utilitarian appliance. The color options — Blue and Red — add a further dimension of personalization that the Ciottoli Dispenser (available in a single colorway) doesn't offer. For multi-pet households where visual differentiation between feeding stations is useful, or simply for owners who want their pet's feeding area to reflect a specific color palette, the Dea Dispenser provides that flexibility. The 1.5L capacity (26×18.5×24cm) is well-suited to cats and small dogs — providing 1–2 days of free-feeding capacity for most cats, or a full day's portion for small breeds. The 3L capacity (33.5×24×29.5cm) scales up for medium-to-large dogs or multi-cat households where a larger reserve between fills is more practical. Key Features: Gravity-fed auto-refill mechanism — no batteries or electronics required Italian Dea design — clean, rounded aesthetic in Blue and Red 2 sizes: 1.5L and 3L reservoir capacity Transparent reservoir for easy food level monitoring Wide, stable base — anti-tip design Smooth interior surfaces — easy to clean Suitable for cats and dogs Ideal for free-feeding, busy households, and short trips Cats and small dogs (up to 8 kg) — the 1.5L provides 1–2 days of free-feeding capacity for most cats, or a full day's portion for small breeds Medium-to-large dogs and multi-cat households — the 3L reduces refill frequency significantly, making it the practical choice for larger pets or busier routines

Available in Blue and Red, in 1.5L and 3L capacities, the Dea Dispenser is the practical, beautiful solution for busy households, free-feeding routines, and owners who want the confidence that their pet always has food available — in a unit that looks as intentional as everything else in their home. Why IMac Dea Food Dispenser Is the Best Choice Gravity-fed auto-refill mechanism — as your pet eats from the bowl, food flows down from the reservoir automatically, maintaining a consistent level without any manual intervention between fills Italian Dea design language — the same clean, rounded aesthetic that defines the Dea range, now in a full dispenser format; functional and beautiful in equal measure Available in Blue and Red — two bold color options to suit your home's aesthetic or to differentiate dispensers in multi-pet households 1.5L and 3L reservoir capacities — the 1.5L suits cats and small dogs with 1–2 days of food between fills; the 3L handles larger dogs or multi-day free-feeding routines No batteries or electronics — the gravity mechanism is passive, reliable, and maintenance-free; nothing to charge, replace, or repair Transparent reservoir section — allows easy visual monitoring of food levels without opening or moving the unit Stable, wide-base design — the dispenser's footprint and low center of gravity keep it stable even during enthusiastic feeding Suitable for both cats and dogs — the dispenser format works across species and feeding styles Product Details & Features The Dea Food Dispenser operates on the same reliable gravity principle as the Ciottoli Dispenser — food stored in an upper reservoir flows down by gravity into the bowl below as the bowl empties. The mechanism is entirely passive: no batteries, no electronics, no moving parts. It works continuously and silently, requiring attention only when the reservoir needs refilling. What distinguishes the Dea Dispenser from the Ciottoli Dispenser is the design language. Where the Ciottoli range is defined by its smooth, pebble-inspired rounded form, the Dea range has its own distinct aesthetic identity — and the Dea Dispenser maintains that identity in a full-height dispenser format. The result is a feeding station that integrates naturally into a home environment as a considered design object rather than a purely utilitarian appliance. The color options — Blue and Red — add a further dimension of personalization that the Ciottoli Dispenser (available in a single colorway) doesn't offer. For multi-pet households where visual differentiation between feeding stations is useful, or simply for owners who want their pet's feeding area to reflect a specific color palette, the Dea Dispenser provides that flexibility. The 1.5L capacity (26×18.5×24cm) is well-suited to cats and small dogs — providing 1–2 days of free-feeding capacity for most cats, or a full day's portion for small breeds. The 3L capacity (33.5×24×29.5cm) scales up for medium-to-large dogs or multi-cat households where a larger reserve between fills is more practical. Key Features: Gravity-fed auto-refill mechanism — no batteries or electronics required Italian Dea design — clean, rounded aesthetic in Blue and Red 2 sizes: 1.5L and 3L reservoir capacity Transparent reservoir for easy food level monitoring Wide, stable base — anti-tip design Smooth interior surfaces — easy to clean Suitable for cats and dogs Ideal for free-feeding, busy households, and short trips Cats and small dogs (up to 8 kg) — the 1.5L provides 1–2 days of free-feeding capacity for most cats, or a full day's portion for small breeds Medium-to-large dogs and multi-cat households — the 3L reduces refill frequency significantly, making it the practical choice for larger pets or busier routines

item.g:title: Perfecto Cat 10X Catsticks Mit Kaninchen & Geflugel 50g
item.g:description: Perfecto Cat — Catsticks Mit Kaninchen & Geflügel (Rabbit & Poultry) | 10 Sticks × 5g | 50g | Premium Cat Treat The most ancestrally authentic treat in the Perfecto Cat range. Catsticks Mit Kaninchen & Geflügel brings together rabbit — the protein that most closely resembles the ancestral feline prey diet — and poultry as the universally appealing, familiar base, in the satisfying chewy stick format that cats hold, chew, and devour with natural instinct. Rabbit is the rarest and most nutritionally exceptional protein in commercial cat food — genuinely novel for virtually every domestic cat, exceptionally lean, exceptionally digestible, and the protein that cats are most biologically designed to eat. Poultry provides the familiar palatability foundation that ensures the formula is accepted enthusiastically even by cats encountering rabbit for the first time. Together, they create the most biologically appropriate and nutritionally distinctive treat in the Perfecto Cat range — 10 individual sticks of German quality, in the protein combination that nature intended. 50g per pack — the ancestral treat for the modern cat. Why Perfecto Cat Catsticks Rabbit & Poultry Is The Best Choice Rabbit — The Most Ancestrally Authentic Protein — Rabbit is the protein that most closely resembles the small prey that cats evolved to hunt — the most biologically appropriate protein available in commercial cat food. Genuinely Novel Protein — Virtually no domestic cat has ever eaten rabbit — making this the most novel protein available in the Perfecto Cat range, ideal for cats with sensitivities to common proteins or who need dietary variety. Exceptionally Lean — Rabbit is one of the leanest animal proteins available — lower in fat than chicken, turkey, or beef — ideal for cats who need high-quality protein without excessive caloric density. Exceptionally Digestible — Rabbit's fine muscle fiber structure makes it one of the most digestible proteins available — maximizing nutrient absorption and minimizing digestive stress. Poultry — The Familiar Foundation — The universally appealing poultry base that provides complete protein, natural taurine, and the familiar palatability that ensures the formula is accepted even by cats encountering rabbit for the first time. Dual Novel + Familiar Protein — Rabbit's novelty and poultry's familiarity create the ideal introduction to novel protein feeding — the cat accepts the familiar poultry while being exposed to the nutritional benefits of rabbit. Natural Taurine from Both Proteins — Both rabbit and poultry are natural taurine sources — the essential amino acid cats cannot synthesize. 10 Individual Sticks — Pre-portioned into 10 individual sticks of ~5g each — perfect daily portion control. Stick Format — The elongated stick format that cats hold between their paws and chew — engaging natural holding and chewing behaviors. German Quality — Perfecto Cat — A trusted German pet food brand with rigorous quality standards. (Visual asset placement: lifestyle photo of a cat holding and chewing a Perfecto Cat stick, or flat-lay of the 10 sticks fanned out from the pack.) Product Details & Features Rabbit — The Ancestral Feline Protein Rabbit is the most significant and distinctive ingredient in this formula — and understanding why rabbit is so exceptional for cats explains why this is the most nutritionally meaningful treat in the Perfecto Cat range. The ancestral diet connection: Domestic cats ( Felis catus ) evolved from the African wildcat ( Felis silvestris lybica ) — a small predator whose natural prey consisted primarily of small mammals (mice, rats, rabbits, hares) and birds. Rabbit and hare were a significant component of the ancestral feline diet — making rabbit the protein that cats are most biologically designed to eat. The nutritional profile of rabbit closely matches the nutritional requirements that feline physiology evolved around: High protein, low fat — matching the lean muscle of small prey Complete amino acid profile — all essential amino acids in proportions that match feline requirements Natural taurine — the essential amino acid that cats evolved to obtain from prey meat Low carbohydrate — matching the near-zero carbohydrate content of whole prey Why rabbit is rare in commercial cat food: Despite being the most biologically appropriate protein for cats, rabbit is rare in commercial cat food — the result of: Higher ingredient cost compared to chicken, tuna, or beef Lower supply chain availability and scalability Less consumer familiarity in most markets Its inclusion in Perfecto Cat Catsticks reflects a genuine commitment to premium ingredient quality — and makes this the most nutritionally distinctive treat in the range. Nutritional profile of rabbit: Exceptionally lean: Rabbit is one of the leanest animal proteins available — leaner than chicken breast, turkey, or any common cat food protein: Protein Fat Content (per 100g) Rabbit ~3–5g Chicken breast ~3–4g Turkey ~4–5g Beef ~15–

Salmon & Tuna Flavour Combination Reflex Plus Salmon & Tuna combines two familiar fish varieties in one wet food recipe. Tender Chunks in Jelly Some cats prefer chunks in jelly rather than gravy or pâté. Added Taurine for Essential Cat Nutrition Taurine is an essential nutrient for cats. It contributes to normal heart function, vision, and other important physiological processes. Vitamins & Minerals for Everyday Nutrition Reflex Plus Salmon & Tuna contains added vitamins and trace minerals, including: Vitamin E: Helps protect cells against oxidative stress. Vitamin D3: Contributes to normal calcium and phosphorus metabolism. Biotin: Plays a role in normal skin and coat maintenance. Zinc: Supports normal skin function and metabolism. Iodine: Contributes to normal thyroid hormone production. These nutrients form part of the recipe's declared nutritional additives. 6. Convenient 85g Pouch The 85g pouch makes it easy to serve a measured amount of wet food. It is practical for owners who prefer individual pouches instead of larger cans. The appropriate daily serving depends on your cat's body weight, nutritional requirements, and whether the food is labelled complete or complementary. Who Is Reflex Plus Salmon & Tuna Suitable For? item.g:description: Taste of the Wild Grain Free Puppy Pacific Stream 12.2kg Dry Dog Food This egg-free recipe gets all its animal protein from fish, meaning that it’s rich in the omega fatty acids that help keep skin healthy and fur smooth and shiny. To help promote sustainable fishing, we use a blend of wild-caught and farmed salmon. * Species Specific Probiotics – Healthy digestive and immune systems are vital to the overall health of your pet. item.g:title: Virbac Cat Advanced Kidney & Joint 3KG
item.g:description: Virbac HPM — Cat Advanced Kidney & Joint The senior cat clinical diet that addresses both conditions at once. Virbac HPM Cat Advanced Kidney & Joint is a veterinary clinical nutrition dry cat food specifically formulated for the two most prevalent and frequently co-occurring conditions in senior cats — chronic kidney disease (CKD) and joint disease (osteoarthritis). These conditions are not coincidental companions — they share common risk factors, common inflammatory mechanisms, and common patient demographics. The senior cat who develops CKD is the same cat who develops joint disease — and managing one condition while ignoring the other produces incomplete clinical outcomes. Virbac HPM addresses both simultaneously through a precisely calibrated nutritional strategy that navigates the most challenging tension in feline clinical nutrition: kidney diets require controlled protein to reduce renal workload, but joint disease requires adequate protein to maintain the lean muscle mass that supports joint function and mobility. Virbac HPM Cat Advanced Kidney & Joint resolves this tension through high-quality, highly digestible protein at precisely controlled levels — providing adequate amino acids for muscle maintenance while minimizing the uremic toxin load on compromised kidneys. Available in 400g (trial size) and 1.5kg. Why Virbac HPM Cat Advanced Kidney & Joint Is The Best Choice Dual Clinical Indication — Simultaneously addresses chronic kidney disease (CKD) and joint disease (osteoarthritis) — the two most prevalent co-occurring conditions in senior cats. Controlled High-Quality Protein — The most clinically precise aspect of the formula — protein is controlled to reduce renal workload while remaining adequate for lean muscle maintenance that supports joint function. Phosphorus Restriction — Reduced phosphorus is the single most important dietary intervention for slowing CKD progression — the Virbac HPM formula provides clinically appropriate phosphorus restriction. Omega-3 (EPA & DHA) — Dual Benefit — Omega-3 fatty acids provide anti-inflammatory benefit for both kidney disease (reducing renal inflammation) and joint disease (reducing synovial inflammation and cartilage degradation). Joint Support Nutrients — Glucosamine and chondroitin sulfate supporting cartilage integrity and synovial fluid quality — the structural joint support nutrients that reduce pain and improve mobility. Antioxidants — Renal & Joint Protection — Vitamins E and C, selenium — reducing oxidative stress that accelerates both kidney damage and cartilage degradation. Alkalizing Effect — Metabolic acidosis is a common complication of CKD — the formula's alkalizing effect supports acid-base balance and reduces the muscle wasting that acidosis causes. High Palatability — Clinical diets are only effective if the cat eats them — the Virbac HPM formula is formulated for high palatability to ensure consistent consumption by cats who may have reduced appetite secondary to CKD. Two Sizes — 400g trial size for initial introduction; 1.5kg for ongoing management. Virbac HPM — Veterinary Expertise — From one of the world's leading animal health companies. (Visual asset placement: flat-lay of both the 400g and 1.5kg Virbac HPM bags, or lifestyle photo of a comfortable senior cat — communicating the quality of life that effective clinical management supports.) item.g:title: Royal Canin Persian Adult Dry Food – (1+ Year Old) 4KG
item.g:description: The Persian cat has the longest and densest coat of all cat breeds. This means that it typically needs to consume more skin-health focused nutrients than other cat breeds. That’s why ROYAL CANIN® Persian Adult contains an exclusive complex of nutrients to help the skin’s barrier defence role to maintain good skin and coat health. Due to their long fur, Persian cats are prone to the formation of hairballs, which can cause discomfort. However, thanks to ROYAL CANIN® Persian Adult, loose ingested hair is eliminated, hairball formation is controlled and intestinal transit is naturally stimulated through a specific blend of fibres (including psyllium rich in mucilage). Digestive performance is also maintained through low indigestible proteins (L.I.P), prebiotics and omega 3 & 6 fatty acids. Not only this, but ROYAL CANIN® Persian Adult’s tailor-made kibble is almond shaped with an optimal contact surface area – making it easy for Persian cats to pick up and chew. To cater to each cat’s individual preferences, ROYAL CANIN® Persian Adult is also available as wet food in a soft and tasty loaf. If you’re considering mixed feeding, simply follow our feeding guidelines to ensure your cat gets an accurate amount of both wet and dry food for optimal benefit. item.g:title: Perfecto Cat 10X Catsticks Mit Geflugel & Leber 50g
item.g:description: Perfecto Cat — Catsticks Mit Geflügel & Leber (Poultry & Liver) | 10 Sticks × 5g | 50g | Premium Cat Treat The most nutrient-dense treat in the Perfecto Cat range. Catsticks Mit Geflügel & Leber brings together poultry — the universally appealing, lean protein foundation — and liver — the most nutritionally concentrated ingredient available in cat food, and one of the most intensely palatable. Liver is nature's multivitamin: exceptionally rich in Vitamin A, Vitamin B12, iron, zinc, copper, and folate — a single ingredient that delivers more micronutrient density per gram than virtually any other food. It is also one of the most powerful palatability triggers for cats — the strong, distinctive aroma and flavor of liver triggers feeding responses that even the most selective cats find impossible to resist. The combination of poultry's lean, complete protein and liver's extraordinary micronutrient density creates the most nutritionally comprehensive treat in the Perfecto Cat range — in the satisfying chewy stick format that cats hold, chew, and devour with natural instinct. 10 individual sticks of German quality — the daily treat that nourishes as it rewards. Why Perfecto Cat Catsticks Poultry & Liver Is The Best Choice Liver — Nature's Multivitamin — The most micronutrient-dense ingredient available in cat food — exceptionally rich in Vitamin A, B12, iron, zinc, and copper in a single, natural ingredient. Maximum Palatability — Liver is one of the most intensely palatable ingredients for cats — the strong, distinctive aroma and flavor triggers feeding responses that even the most selective cats find impossible to resist. Vitamin A — The Essential Feline Vitamin — Cats cannot convert beta-carotene to Vitamin A (unlike dogs and humans) — they must obtain preformed Vitamin A directly from animal sources. Liver is the richest natural source of preformed Vitamin A available. Vitamin B12 — The Energy Vitamin — Liver is one of the richest natural sources of B12 — supporting nervous system function, energy metabolism, and red blood cell production. Heme Iron — Liver is exceptionally rich in heme iron — the most bioavailable form — supporting oxygen transport, energy, and immune function. Copper — Liver is the richest natural source of dietary copper — supporting iron metabolism, immune function, and coat pigmentation. Poultry — The Familiar Foundation — The universally appealing poultry base that provides complete protein, natural taurine, and the familiar palatability that ensures the formula is accepted enthusiastically. The Selective Eater Solution — The liver's intense aroma and flavor consistently converts cats who have rejected other treats — the most palatable formula in the Perfecto Cat range. 10 Individual Sticks — Pre-portioned into 10 individual sticks of ~5g each — perfect daily portion control. German Quality — Perfecto Cat — A trusted German pet food brand with rigorous quality standards. (Visual asset placement: lifestyle photo of a cat holding and chewing a Perfecto Cat stick with visible enthusiasm, or flat-lay of the 10 sticks with the poultry and liver branding prominent.) Product Details & Features Liver — The Most Nutritionally Dense Ingredient in Cat Food Liver is the defining ingredient of this formula — and understanding why liver is so nutritionally exceptional explains why this is the most micronutrient-rich treat in the Perfecto Cat range. What liver is: Liver is an organ meat — the primary metabolic organ of the animal, responsible for processing nutrients, filtering toxins, and producing essential compounds. Because the liver is the site of nutrient processing and storage, it accumulates extraordinarily high concentrations of vitamins and minerals — making it the most nutrient-dense food available in the animal kingdom. Why liver is exceptional for cats: Vitamin A — The Critical Feline Distinction: Liver's most important nutritional contribution for cats is preformed Vitamin A (retinol) — and this is where cats differ fundamentally from dogs and humans: Cats cannot convert beta-carotene to Vitamin A — Unlike dogs and humans, cats lack the enzyme (beta-carotene dioxygenase) required to convert plant-derived beta-carotene into Vitamin A. They must obtain preformed Vitamin A (retinol) directly from animal sources. Liver is the richest natural source of preformed Vitamin A — Liver contains more preformed Vitamin A per gram than any other food — making it the most important dietary source of this essential vitamin for cats. Vitamin A functions in cats: Vision — Vitamin A is essential for the production of rhodopsin, the light-sensitive pigment in the retina — supporting both day and night vision Immune function — Vitamin A is required for the development and function of immune cells — particularly the mucosal immune system that protects the respiratory and digestive tracts Skin and coat health — Vitamin A supports skin cell turnover, sebum production, and the maintenance of healthy skin and co

Why Use a Pet Hair Lint Roller? Pet hair can quickly collect on clothes and furniture, especially in homes with shedding cats and dogs. item.g:title: Virbac Puppy Small & Toy 3KG
item.g:description: Virbac HPM — Puppy Small & Toy | Veterinary-Grade Dry Puppy Food The foundation of a healthy small breed life. Virbac HPM Puppy Small & Toy is a veterinary-grade growth diet specifically formulated for the unique nutritional requirements of small and toy breed puppies — the breeds whose rapid early development, high metabolic rate, and small stomach capacity demand a fundamentally different nutritional approach from medium and large breed puppy foods. Small and toy breed puppies are not simply smaller versions of large breed puppies — they grow faster relative to their adult size, reach maturity earlier, burn more calories per kilogram of body weight, and have smaller mouths and stomachs that require smaller kibble and higher energy density per gram of food. Virbac HPM Puppy Small & Toy is formulated to address every one of these specific requirements — high energy density for the small breed metabolic rate, optimal protein for rapid muscle and organ development, precise calcium and phosphorus ratios for small breed skeletal development, DHA for brain and vision development, and a kibble size designed for small mouths. Veterinary-grade nutrition from Virbac — the animal health company that applies pharmaceutical-grade scientific rigor to every product it produces. 3kg — the growth diet that gives small breed puppies the nutritional foundation they deserve. Why Virbac HPM Puppy Small & Toy Is The Best Choice Small & Toy Breed Specific — Formulated specifically for the unique metabolic, developmental, and physical requirements of small and toy breed puppies — not a generic puppy food adapted for small breeds. High Energy Density — Small and toy breed puppies have a metabolic rate 2–3× higher per kilogram than large breeds — the high energy density formula meets this elevated caloric requirement in the small portions their stomachs can accommodate. Optimal Protein for Rapid Development — High-quality protein supporting the rapid muscle, organ, and tissue development that characterizes the small breed growth phase. Precise Calcium & Phosphorus Ratios — Carefully calibrated calcium and phosphorus levels for small breed skeletal development — avoiding the over-supplementation that can cause developmental orthopedic disease. DHA for Brain & Vision Development — Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) is the critical Omega-3 for neurological and retinal development — supporting cognitive development and visual acuity during the critical early growth phase. Small Kibble Size — Kibble sized for small mouths and developing teeth — ensuring comfortable eating and adequate chewing for small and toy breed puppies. Immune System Support — Antioxidants and immune-supporting nutrients for the developing immune system of growing puppies. Digestive Support — Highly digestible ingredients and prebiotic fiber supporting the sensitive digestive system of small breed puppies. Virbac HPM — Veterinary Expertise — From one of the world's leading animal health companies — veterinary-grade nutrition for the most critical phase of your dog's life. Complete & Balanced for Growth — Formulated to meet the AAFCO/FEDIAF nutritional standards for growth — all essential nutrients for complete puppy development. (Visual asset placement: lifestyle photo of a small or toy breed puppy eating from a bowl of Virbac HPM kibble, or flat-lay of the bag with a small breed puppy alongside — communicating the breed-specific positioning.) Product Details & Features Why Small & Toy Breed Puppies Need a Specific Formula The distinction between small/toy breed puppy nutrition and general puppy nutrition is not a marketing differentiation — it reflects genuine, clinically significant differences in the physiology and development of small breed dogs: Growth rate and maturity timeline: Small/toy breeds (adult weight <10 kg) — Reach adult size at 8–12 months Medium breeds (adult weight 10–25 kg) — Reach adult size at 12–15 months Large breeds (adult weight 25–45 kg) — Reach adult size at 15–18 months Giant breeds (adult weight >45 kg) — Reach adult size at 18–24 months Small and toy breed puppies complete their growth in a shorter period — but their growth is proportionally more rapid relative to their adult size. This rapid growth requires higher energy density and higher protein concentration per gram of food than slower-growing large breed puppies. Metabolic rate: Small and toy breed dogs have a significantly higher metabolic rate per kilogram of body weight than large breeds — a consequence of their higher surface-area-to-volume ratio (smaller bodies lose heat more rapidly and must generate more heat per kilogram to maintain body temperature). This elevated metabolic rate means: Small breed puppies require more calories per kilogram of body weight than large breed puppies They must eat more frequently relative to their body size Their food must be more energy-dense — they cannot eat enough volume to meet their caloric needs from a low-density food Stomach capacity: Small

item.g:title: Royal Canin Digestive Care Dog Pouch Loaf 85g
item.g:description: Details Wet food for dogs Complete feed for dogs - For adult dogs over 10 months old - Dogs prone to digestive sensitivity. PRODUCT DETAILS Digestive sensitivities in dogs can often be identified by the consistency and frequency of their stools. Larger dogs with upset stomachs tend to produce runnier stools at a higher frequency, while smaller dogs tend to experience constipation and produce more solid stools. A wide variety of different factors can influence digestive sensitivities in dogs, including age, weight, and breed. But with the right diet, your dog can benefit from nutrients that help to support healthy digestion. ROYAL CANIN® Digestive Care Loaf is a precisely balanced nutritional formula that is specifically created to support healthier digestion in dogs with digestive sensitivities. This food is suitable for dogs of all breeds, shapes and sizes. A diet that is too varied can result in further digestive issues and upset the balance of the good bacteria, or 'microflora' , in your dog's gut. Microflora encourages a healthy digestive environment and can be supported by the right diet containing the right nutrients. This food contains specially selected nutrients that are highly digestible and easy to absorb. The exclusive blend of fibres, prebiotics and protein in this product help to facilitate a good digestive environment that supports healthy digestion. Composition: Meat and animal derivatives, cereals, derivatives of vegetable origin, minerals. Additives (per kg): Nutritional additives: Vitamin D3: 170 IU, Iron (3b103): 5 mg, Iodine (3b202): 0.25 mg, Copper (3b405, 3b406): 2 mg, Manganese (3b502, 3b503, 3b504): 1.5 mg, Zinc (3b603, 3b605, 3b606): 15 mg - Technological additives: Clinoptilolite of sedimentary origin: 2.2 g. Analytical constituents: Protein: 8.6% - Crude fibres: 1.3% - Fat content: 5.8% - Crude ash: 1.8% - Moisture: 78.9%.

item.g:title: Royal Canin Hairball Care Dry Food – (Hairball Prevention, Adult Cats) 2KG
item.g:description: Cats often spend large parts of its day self-grooming, and can therefore swallow large quantities of hair. This ingested hair can become compacted in the digestive tract, resulting in the formation of hairballs which are then either regurgitated or eliminated through its faces. ROYAL CANIN® Hairball Care is composed of a specific blend of dietary fibres, including psyllium (rich in mucilage) and insoluble fibres to help naturally stimulate healthy intestinal transit. As a result, hair swallowed daily can be eliminated in its faeces rather than building up in the stomach and being regurgitated. ROYAL CANIN® Hairball Care contains a precise combination of nutrients with a high protein content (34%) and a high fat content (15%) to ensure that a healthy level of nutrients is maintained effectively. ROYAL CANIN® Hairball Care has been proven to eliminate twice as much excess hair in a cat’s body after just 14 days of feeding. To cater to each cat’s individual preferences, ROYAL CANIN® Hairball Care is also available as wet food in delicious gravy. If you’re considering mixed feeding, simply follow our feeding guidelines to ensure your cat gets an accurate amount of both wet and dry food for optimal benefit. The YZHTBrush Dental Care Kit gives you a choice between a regular double-ended toothbrush and finger toothbrushes, making it easier to find a brushing method your dog accepts. The included toothpaste is labelled for pet dental care and is intended to be used according to the manufacturer's instructions. Double-Ended Toothbrush & Finger Brushes Double-Ended Toothbrush The long-handled toothbrush features two brush heads, providing different brushing angles for reaching your dog's teeth. Finger Toothbrushes The included red and yellow finger toothbrushes offer another way to brush your dog's teeth with direct hand control. Introduce finger brushing gradually, particularly if your dog is unfamiliar with dental care. How to Use Allow your dog to become familiar with the toothpaste and toothbrushes. item.g:title: Revolution Topical Solution for Dogs, 40.1-85 lbs - 1 Pipette
item.g:description: Your furry friend must have a current heartworm test result on file with your veterinarian in order to be prescribed heartworm medication. Please visit your veterinarian to have this test performed annually to protect your four-legged friend. Revolution is a medication that is applied directly on your furry friend's skin to protect them from biting critters. When applied every 30 days, Revolution protects against heartworms, fleas, and ear mites. It's also effective in preventing and treating roundworms and hookworms in kittens and sarcoptic mange and American dog tick infestations in puppies. Uses Revolution is formulated to kill adult fleas and prevents flea eggs from hatching for one month. It is also indicated for the prevention and control of flea infestations, prevention of heartworm disease caused by Dirofilaria immitis, and the treatment and control of ear mite infestations. Revolution is also indicated for the treatment and control of sarcoptic mange and for the control of tick infestations due to Dermacentor variabilis. Possible Side Effects In safety studies, Revolution was administered at 1, 3, 5, and 10 times the recommended dose to sixweek-old puppies, and no adverse reactions were observed. When tested for oral ingestion at the recommended topical dose in 5 to 8-month-old beagles, no adverse reactions were observed. In a topical safety study conducted with avermectinsensitive collies at 1, 3 and 5 times the recommended dose of Revolution, salivation was observed in all treatment groups. Revolution also was administered at 3 times the recommended dose to heartworm infected dogs, and no adverse effects were observed. If side effects do occur, please contact your veterinarian immediately. Drug & Food Interactions Talk to your veterinarian about any other drugs your dog is taking before starting this medication. Precautions Prior to administration of Revolution, dogs should be tested for existing heartworm infections. At the discretion of the veterinarian, infected dogs should be treated to remove adult heartworms. Revolution is not effective against adult D. immitis and, while the number of circulating microfilariae may decrease following treatment, Revolution is not effective for microfilariae clearance. Hypersensitivity reactions have not been observed in dogs with patent heartworm infections administered three times the recommended dose of Revolution. Higher doses were not tested. For use in animals only. Keep out of reach of children. The IMac Dea Double Bowl brings the clean Italian design and anti-slip feet of the Dea single bowl to a twin-bowl format — a dedicated food and water station that keeps everything organized, stable, and beautifully presented side by side. Available in Blue and Red, at the most accessible price point in the IMac double bowl range, the Dea Double Bowl is the practical, well-designed choice for cat owners and small dog households who want a proper feeding station without compromise. Why IMac Dea Double Bowl Is the Best Choice Anti-slip feet — the Dea difference — rubber anti-slip feet on the base keep the double bowl station firmly in place during feeding, eliminating the sliding and tipping that makes mealtime messier than it needs to be; a feature not found on all double bowl formats at this price point Two bowls, one station — food and water (or two food types) side by side in a single, stable unit; no more scattered bowls, no more searching for where the water bowl ended up Italian Dea design language — the same clean, rounded aesthetic that defines the Dea single bowl, Dea Slow Feeder, and Dea Food Dispenser; a visually cohesive feeding area for owners building a complete Dea setup Available in Blue and Red — two bold color options for personalization, aesthetic matching, or easy visual differentiation in multi-pet households Most accessible double bowl in the IMac range — the Dea Double Bowl delivers the quality and design of the IMac lineup at the most approachable price point in the double bowl category Encourages better hydration — having water consistently adjacent to food is one of the most effective ways to increase water intake in cats, who are naturally reluctant drinkers Suitable for both cats and dogs — a single product that works across species Product Details & Features The Dea Double Bowl combines two of the Dea range's defining characteristics — the clean Italian aesthetic and the anti-slip rubber feet — in a twin-bowl format that solves the most common daily feeding frustration: bowls that move. item.g:title: IMac Dea Single Bowl for Pet Blue / 0.45L (16.2*6 Cm)
item.g:description: IMac Dea Bowl for Pets The everyday bowl, done properly. The IMac Dea Bowl is the standard feeding bowl of the Dea range — clean Italian design, two bold colors, four sizes that cover every pet from small cats to large dogs, and a detail that sets it apart from most bowls at this price point: anti-slip feet on the base that keep it exactly where you put it, every single meal. No sliding. No chasing the bowl across the floor. Just a well-designed, well-built bowl that does its job reliably, day after day. Why IMac Dea Bowl Is the Best Choice Anti-slip feet — the detail that matters — rubber anti-slip feet on the base keep the Dea Bowl firmly in place during feeding, eliminating the sliding and tipping that makes mealtime messier than it needs to be Italian Dea design — the same clean, rounded aesthetic that defines the Dea Slow Feeder and Dea Food Dispenser, maintaining visual consistency across the full Dea feeding station setup Available in Blue and Red — two bold color options for personalization, aesthetic matching, or easy differentiation between food and water bowls in multi-pet households Four sizes for every pet — from 0.45L for small cats and toy breeds to 3L for large and giant breed dogs, the Dea Bowl range covers the complete spectrum in a single, consistent design Smooth interior surfaces — no corners or crevices where food residue can accumulate; easy to clean thoroughly after every use Pairs perfectly with the Dea Slow Feeder and Dea Food Dispenser — for owners building a complete Dea feeding station, the Dea Bowl is the natural companion piece for water or a second food type Suitable for both cats and dogs — one design, every pet Product Details & Features The anti-slip feet are the Dea Bowl's standout functional feature — and a more meaningful one than it might initially appear. Bowls that slide during feeding are a genuine daily frustration: food spills, water splashes, and pets learn to chase their bowl rather than eat calmly from it. The rubber feet on the Dea Bowl's base create enough friction against most floor surfaces — tile, hardwood, laminate — to keep the bowl stationary even during enthusiastic feeding, making mealtimes calmer and cleaner for both pet and owner. The Dea Bowl's design language is consistent with the rest of the Dea range — the same rounded, clean-lined aesthetic that makes the Dea Slow Feeder and Dea Food Dispenser immediately recognizable. For owners who want a cohesive, matched feeding area, the Dea Bowl is the natural choice for the water station or secondary food bowl alongside the Dea Slow Feeder or Dea Dispenser. The four-size range scales appropriately with pet size — not just in capacity, but in the physical dimensions of the bowl itself. A 0.45L bowl for a small cat is proportionally different from a 3L bowl for a large dog, ensuring that the eating experience is comfortable and natural at every size. Key Features: Anti-slip rubber feet — stays in place on tile, hardwood, and laminate Italian Dea design — clean, rounded aesthetic in Blue and Red 4 sizes: 0.45L, 1L, 2L, 3L Smooth interior surfaces — easy to clean Pairs with Dea Slow Feeder and Dea Food Dispenser for a complete feeding station Suitable for cats and dogs of all sizes

item.g:title: Virbac Pyoderm for Dog & Cat 250ML VBI
item.g:description: Virbac — Pyoderm | 250ml | Veterinary Antibacterial Shampoo for Dogs & Cats The veterinary standard for bacterial skin infections. Virbac Pyoderm is a veterinary-grade antibacterial shampoo specifically formulated to treat pyoderma — bacterial skin infections — and associated skin conditions in dogs and cats. Pyoderma is one of the most common dermatological conditions in dogs and a significant cause of skin disease in cats — characterized by bacterial colonization of the skin that produces pustules, papules, crusts, scaling, hair loss, redness, and the characteristic unpleasant odor of infected skin. Standard grooming shampoos cannot treat pyoderma — bacterial skin infections require the specific antibacterial active ingredients that only veterinary-grade shampoos provide. Virbac Pyoderm delivers clinically proven antibacterial action — targeting the bacteria responsible for canine and feline pyoderma, reducing the bacterial burden on infected skin, supporting the resolution of active infections, and preventing recurrence when used as part of a comprehensive dermatological management program. From Virbac — the veterinary dermatology brand that professionals trust worldwide. 250ml — the veterinary antibacterial shampoo that treats pyoderma at its source. Why Virbac Pyoderm Is The Best Choice Veterinary Antibacterial Formula — Specifically formulated to treat pyoderma and bacterial skin infections — not a general grooming shampoo, but a genuine veterinary antibacterial treatment. Chlorhexidine — The Gold Standard Veterinary Antibacterial — Chlorhexidine is the most widely used and most clinically validated antibacterial agent in veterinary dermatology — broad-spectrum, residual activity, and excellent safety profile. Broad-Spectrum Antibacterial Coverage — Effective against the primary bacterial pathogens responsible for canine and feline pyoderma — particularly Staphylococcus pseudintermedius, the most common cause of canine pyoderma. Residual Antibacterial Activity — Chlorhexidine binds to skin proteins and maintains antibacterial activity between baths — providing ongoing protection beyond the bathing session. Surface Decontamination — Reduces the bacterial burden on the skin surface — supporting the resolution of active infections and preventing recolonization. Adjunctive Therapy — Used alongside systemic antibiotics for moderate to severe pyoderma — topical antibacterial shampoo reduces the bacterial burden and supports faster resolution. Monotherapy for Superficial Pyoderma — For mild, superficial pyoderma, topical antibacterial shampoo alone may be sufficient — reducing the need for systemic antibiotics. Recurrence Prevention — Regular use as a maintenance shampoo prevents bacterial recolonization in dogs prone to recurrent pyoderma. For Dogs & Cats — Formulated for use in both species. Virbac — Veterinary Dermatology Expertise — From one of the world's leading animal health companies. (Visual asset placement: flat-lay of the Virbac Pyoderm bottle with the clinical branding prominent, or lifestyle photo of a healthy dog or cat with clean, infection-free skin.) Product Details & Features Understanding Pyoderma in Dogs and Cats Pyoderma (from the Greek "pyo" = pus, "derma" = skin) is a bacterial skin infection — one of the most common dermatological conditions in dogs and a significant cause of skin disease in cats. Understanding pyoderma explains why a veterinary antibacterial shampoo is essential for effective management: Prevalence: Pyoderma is the most common skin condition in dogs — accounting for approximately 20–30% of all dermatological consultations In cats, pyoderma is less common but occurs secondary to wounds, bite injuries, and underlying skin conditions Classification by depth: Superficial pyoderma: Infection confined to the surface of the skin and hair follicle openings Presents as pustules, papules, epidermal collarettes (circular scales), and superficial crusts Most common form — often responds to topical antibacterial treatment alone Includes impetigo (puppy pyoderma), superficial bacterial folliculitis, and mucocutaneous pyoderma Deep pyoderma: Infection extending into the dermis and subcutaneous tissue Presents as nodules, draining tracts, furunculosis (ruptured hair follicles), and cellulitis Requires systemic antibiotic therapy — topical treatment is adjunctive More serious — can cause scarring and systemic illness Causes and risk factors: Pyoderma is almost always secondary to an underlying condition that disrupts the skin barrier or immune defense: Allergies — Atopic dermatitis (environmental allergy) and food allergy are the most common underlying causes — the chronic scratching and skin barrier disruption allow bacteria to colonize Parasites — Demodicosis (Demodex mites) causes immunosuppression that allows bacterial overgrowth Hormonal disorders — Hypothyroidism and hyperadrenocorticism (Cushing's disease) impair immune function Anatomical factors — Skin folds (in brachycephal

item.g:title: IMac Ciottoli Double Bowel Feeder for Pet 0.6+0.6L (39.5*23*6.5 Cm)
item.g:description: IMac Double Feeder Ciottoli for Pets One station. Two bowls. Everything your pet needs, right where they need it. The IMac Double Feeder Ciottoli brings the same smooth, pebble-inspired Italian design of the single Ciottoli to a twin-bowl format — giving you a dedicated food and water station in a single, elegant unit that keeps feeding areas organized, tidy, and genuinely beautiful. Available in two sizes to suit cats and small-to-medium dogs, the Double Feeder Ciottoli is the upgrade that makes daily feeding simpler, cleaner, and more considered. Why IMac Double Feeder Ciottoli Is the Best Choice Two bowls, one station — the double format keeps food and water (or two food types) side by side in a single, stable unit, eliminating the clutter of separate bowls scattered across the floor Italian design heritage — IMac's signature pebble-inspired aesthetic brings a clean, considered look to the feeding area that single-purpose plastic bowls simply can't match Ideal food + water combination — the most practical use of the double format; having water always adjacent to food encourages better hydration habits, particularly in cats who are reluctant drinkers Stable, wide-base design — the joined double-bowl unit has a naturally wider footprint than two separate bowls, making it significantly more stable and resistant to tipping during enthusiastic feeding Smooth interior surfaces — no corners or crevices where food or water residue can accumulate; easy to clean thoroughly after every use Two sizes for cats and small-to-medium dogs — the 0.3+0.3L suits cats and toy breeds; the 0.6+0.6L handles small-to-medium dogs and larger cats comfortably Barcodes present on both variants ✓ — full product traceability Product Details & Features The Double Feeder Ciottoli solves one of the most common practical frustrations of pet ownership: the perpetually sliding, tipping, or scattered bowl situation. By joining two Ciottoli bowls into a single unit with a shared base, IMac creates a feeding station that stays exactly where you put it, presents food and water in a clean, organized way, and takes up a defined, predictable footprint in your home. The food-and-water combination is the most popular use case — and for good reason. Cats in particular benefit from having water consistently available adjacent to their food, as proximity to the food source is one of the factors that influences how much water they drink. For cats who are chronically underhydrated — a common issue that contributes to kidney and urinary tract problems — a double feeder that keeps water always in view and always accessible is a genuinely meaningful health intervention. The double format is also useful for multi-food households: raw and dry, wet and dry, or two different food types for cats with specific dietary requirements. The two bowls are independent in use but unified in design, giving owners flexibility without sacrificing the clean, organized look of the feeding area. The Ciottoli design language — smooth curves, rounded edges, no sharp corners — carries through to the double format, making it as easy to clean as the single bowl and as comfortable to handle when moving or washing. Key Features: Double bowl format — food + water or two food types in one station Italian design — smooth, rounded pebble-inspired aesthetic 2 sizes: 0.3+0.3L and 0.6+0.6L Wide, stable joined base — anti-tip, anti-slide design Smooth interior surfaces — easy to clean, no food-trapping corners Suitable for cats and dogs Durable construction — built for daily use

item.g:title: Dogness Recovery E-Collar Size 7 (neck 15–18 cm)
item.g:description: DOGNESS Professional Recovery E-Collar Series (7-Size Range) The DOGNESS E-Collar is the gold standard for post-operative care and wound protection. Designed to prevent licking, biting, and scratching, this series provides a secure barrier without sacrificing your pet's peripheral vision or comfort. Product Highlights: Full Size Spectrum: Available in 7 distinct sizes (Size 1 to Size 7), covering neck circumferences from tiny kittens to giant breed dogs. Translucent Design: Made from high-quality, lightweight translucent plastic to reduce the "closed-in" feeling and help pets navigate their environment safely. Soft Padded Edges: Features a cushioned fabric or rubber outer rim to prevent the collar from digging into the pet’s neck or scratching your furniture. Secure Fastening: Equipped with adjustable snap-closures or heavy-duty Velcro for a "custom fit" that stays put even on active pets. Easy Maintenance: Completely waterproof and wipeable—essential for maintaining hygiene during the healing process. Sizing Guide (Quick Reference) Size Neck Circumference (cm) Depth/Height (cm) Typical Breed Example 7 15–18 cm 8 cm Kittens, Toy Poodles 6 18–22 cm 11 cm Cats, Pomeranians 5 23–27 cm 12.5 cm Jack Russells, Shih Tzus 4 28–33 cm 13 cm Beagles, French Bulldogs 3 34–40 cm 18 cm Border Collies, Spaniels 2 41–48 cm 20 cm Labradors, Boxers 1 49–60+ cm 28 cm German Shepherds, Great Danes Why the 7-Size System Matters: A poorly fitted collar is either easy to escape from or too heavy for the pet to lift. With 7 incremental sizes , you eliminate the "in-between" struggle, ensuring the collar is long enough to pass the nose (preventing licking) but light enough for the pet to eat and sleep comfortably.

Product Features Formulated for dogs weighing 20 to 40 kg Single tablet protects for up to 12 weeks Fast-acting – kills fleas within 2 hours of ingestion Effective against Ixodes ricinus, Rhipicephalus sanguineus, and Dermacentor reticulatus ticks Systemic protection – no need to worry about topical wash-off Palatable chewable format accepted by most dogs Breaks the flea life cycle to prevent reinfestation Active Ingredient Fluralaner 1000 mg – provides systemic ectoparasitic protection through the blood-feeding mechanism. Dosing Guide Dog Weight Tablet Strength Dosing interval 20 - 40 kg Bravecto 1000 mg Every 12 weeks Administer with a meal. item.g:title: IMac Food Dispenser Ciottoli for Pet 3L (29.5*23.5*29 Cm)
item.g:description: IMac Food Dispenser Ciottoli for Pets The feeding bowl that refills itself. The IMac Food Dispenser Ciottoli takes the elegant, pebble-inspired design of the Ciottoli range and elevates it into a fully functional gravity-fed dispenser — a reservoir unit that automatically releases food into the bowl as your pet eats, keeping the feeding station consistently stocked without constant manual refilling. Available in 1.5L and 3L capacities, it's the practical, beautiful solution for busy households, free-feeding routines, and owners who want the peace of mind that their pet always has food available — in a unit that looks as considered as everything else in their home. Why IMac Food Dispenser Ciottoli Is the Best Choice Gravity-fed auto-refill mechanism — as your pet eats from the bowl, food flows down from the reservoir automatically, maintaining a consistent level without any manual intervention between fills Italian Ciottoli design language — the same smooth, rounded pebble-inspired aesthetic that defines the Ciottoli bowl range, now in a full dispenser format; functional and beautiful in equal measure 1.5L and 3L reservoir capacities — the 1.5L suits cats and small dogs with 1–2 days of food between fills; the 3L handles larger dogs or multi-day free-feeding routines Reduces feeding frequency — ideal for busy owners, short trips away, or households where consistent manual feeding times are difficult to maintain Stable, wide-base design — the dispenser's low center of gravity and wide footprint keep it stable even during enthusiastic feeding Transparent reservoir — allows easy visual monitoring of food levels without opening or moving the unit Suitable for both cats and dogs — the dispenser format works across species and feeding styles Product Details & Features Gravity dispensers work on a simple, reliable principle: food is stored in an upper reservoir and flows down by gravity into the bowl below as the bowl empties. There are no batteries, no electronics, and no moving parts to maintain or replace — just a clean, passive mechanism that keeps the bowl consistently stocked as long as the reservoir has food in it. The IMac Ciottoli Dispenser applies this principle within the Ciottoli design framework — maintaining the smooth, rounded aesthetic of the bowl range while adding the practical functionality of a reservoir system. The result is a feeding station that looks like a considered design object rather than a utilitarian plastic container, and that performs reliably day after day without requiring attention. The 1.5L capacity (27×19×24cm) is well-suited to cats and small dogs — providing enough food for 1–2 days of free-feeding for most cats, or a full day's portion for small breeds. The 3L capacity (29.5×23.5×29cm) scales up for medium-to-large dogs or multi-cat households where a larger reserve between fills is more practical. The transparent reservoir section allows owners to monitor food levels at a glance — no need to open the unit or estimate by weight. When the reservoir runs low, simply open the top, refill, and the dispenser takes care of the rest. Key Features: Gravity-fed auto-refill mechanism — no batteries or electronics required Italian Ciottoli design — smooth, rounded pebble-inspired aesthetic 2 sizes: 1.5L and 3L reservoir capacity Transparent reservoir for easy food level monitoring Wide, stable base — anti-tip design Smooth interior surfaces — easy to clean Suitable for cats and dogs Ideal for free-feeding, busy households, and short trips

item.g:title: IMac Diva 22 Double Bowl for Pet 0.4+0.4L (32.5*16.5*6.3 Cm) Blue
item.g:description: IMac Diva Double Bowl for Pets Two bowls. One station. The Diva aesthetic. The IMac Diva Double Bowl brings the clean, considered design of the Diva range to a twin-bowl format — a dedicated food and water station that keeps everything organized, tidy, and beautifully presented in a single unit. At 0.4+0.4L per bowl, it's sized for cats and small-to-medium dogs, and available in Blue and Red to suit your home's color palette or to differentiate stations in multi-pet households. The practical upgrade that makes daily feeding simpler, cleaner, and more intentional. Why IMac Diva Double Bowl Is the Best Choice Two bowls, one station — food and water (or two food types) side by side in a single, stable unit; no more scattered bowls, no more sliding across the floor Diva design language — the same clean, Italian aesthetic that defines the Diva single bowl range, now in a twin-bowl format that maintains design consistency across your feeding area Available in Blue and Red — two bold color options for personalization, aesthetic matching, or easy visual differentiation in multi-pet households 0.4+0.4L capacity — perfectly sized for cats and small-to-medium dogs; enough for a full meal in one bowl and a generous water supply in the other Wide, stable footprint — the joined double-bowl unit has a naturally broader base than two separate bowls, making it significantly more resistant to tipping and sliding during feeding Smooth interior surfaces — no corners or crevices where food or water residue can accumulate; easy to clean thoroughly after every use Encourages better hydration — having water consistently adjacent to food is one of the most effective ways to increase water intake in cats, who are naturally reluctant drinkers Product Details & Features The Diva Double Bowl occupies a specific and practical niche in the IMac lineup. The 0.4+0.4L capacity per bowl is calibrated for cats and small-to-medium dogs — providing enough volume for a full meal in the food bowl and a meaningful water reserve in the water bowl, without the unit becoming unwieldy in smaller living spaces. For households with a single cat or a small dog, this is the ideal all-in-one feeding station size. The color choice — Blue or Red — adds the same personalization dimension that distinguishes the Diva range from the single-colorway Ciottoli Double Feeder. item.g:description: For the little mischief-maker who already has your whole heart. The Little Monster Plush Pet Hoodie brings playful personality to your companion’s wardrobe with a bright yellow-green plush finish and an oversized eye design on the back. A matching hood completes the look, making it a charming choice for pet portraits and supervised dress-up moments. Why Choose the Little Monster Plush Pet Hoodie? Playful monster styling: A large cream-and-black eye detail creates a distinctive character look. Standout colour: A vibrant yellow-green shade adds a cheerful touch to your pet’s wardrobe. Plush texture: A fluffy exterior gives the hoodie its cosy-looking finish. Coordinated details: A matching hood, ribbed sleeve cuffs and ribbed hem bring the design together. Four size options: Choose from XS, S, M and L using the measurements below. Product Details & Features This short-sleeved pet hoodie features a textured yellow-green body with a matching hood. The oversized eye design sits across the back, contrasting with the plush surface for a simple but expressive finish. The product photos show the hoodie laid flat and worn by a dog, helping you explore the colour, eye placement and overall shape. Use your pet’s measurements rather than the model’s appearance when selecting a size. Specifications & Sizing Product type: Plush pet hoodie Supplier: Fur N Fit Colour: Yellow-green Design: Single-eye monster styling Exterior texture: Plush Hood: Matching plush hood Sleeves: Short sleeves with ribbed cuffs Hem: Ribbed Available sizes: XS, S, M and L Size | Back Length | Chest | Neck XS | 30.32 cm | 35.40 cm | 16.22 cm S | 33.35 cm | 40.45 cm | 20.26 cm M | 38.42 cm | 45.50 cm | 24.30 cm L | 43.48 cm | 50.55 cm | 28.34 cm How to Measure Your Pet Back length: Measure from the base of the neck to the base of the tail. Chest: Measure around the widest part of the ribcage. Neck: Measure around the base of the neck. Compare all three measurements with the size guide before ordering. Do not choose a size based on breed or weight alone. Wear & Care Supervise your pet while wearing the hoodie. Keep the hood clear of their eyes and nose, and check that the neck, chest and sleeves allow comfortable movement. Remove the garment if your pet appears uncomfortable, becomes too warm or starts chewing the fabric or decorative detail. Follow the garment’s care label for washing and drying instructions.

Do not leave it on an unattended or crated pet. Follow the garment’s care label for washing and drying instructions.

item.g:description: VIRBAC Effitix Spot-On for Dogs Large (20–40 kg) VIRBAC Effitix Spot-On is a monthly topical solution that provides reliable protection against fleas, ticks, and biting flies in dogs. Developed by VIRBAC, a globally recognized leader in veterinary products, Effitix combines two active ingredients to deliver broad-spectrum parasite control through a simple spot-on application. The Large variant is formulated for dogs weighing between 20 and 40 kg, making it suitable for a wide range of medium-to-large breeds. Applied directly to the skin between the shoulder blades, it spreads over the coat and skin to provide full-body protection against external parasites for up to four weeks. For dogs that are difficult to medicate orally, or for owners who prefer topical treatments, Effitix is an excellent option that is easy to apply and highly effective. How to Apply Part the fur between the shoulder blades to expose the skin. Apply the entire contents of the pipette directly to the skin. Avoid contact with the dog's eyes or mouth. Do not bathe the dog for 48 hours before or after application. Dosing Guide Dog Weight Variant Application Interval 20 - 40 kg Effitix Large Every 4 weeks Do not use on cats. item.g:title: Virbac Cat Urology Urinary WIB 1.5Kg
item.g:description: Virbac HPM — Cat Urology Urinary WIB | 400g / 1.5kg | Veterinary Clinical Dry Cat Food The urinary diet that protects against both crystal types. Virbac HPM Cat Urology Urinary WIB is a veterinary clinical nutrition dry cat food specifically formulated to support feline urinary health — preventing and managing the full spectrum of feline lower urinary tract disease (FLUTD), including struvite crystals, calcium oxalate crystals, idiopathic cystitis, and urethral plugs. The "WIB" designation reflects the most clinically sophisticated aspect of this formula — a precisely balanced mineral profile that simultaneously prevents struvite crystal formation and calcium oxalate crystal formation, the two most common urinary crystal types in cats. Most urinary diets address one crystal type effectively but inadvertently promote the other — acidifying diets dissolve struvite but increase calcium oxalate risk; alkalizing diets prevent calcium oxalate but promote struvite. Virbac HPM Urinary WIB navigates this clinical tension through precise mineral balance, controlled pH targeting, and high moisture encouragement — protecting the entire urinary tract without compromising against either crystal type. Available in 400g (trial size) and 1.5kg. Why Virbac HPM Cat Urology Urinary WIB Is The Best Choice Dual Crystal Protection — Struvite & Calcium Oxalate — The WIB formula simultaneously prevents both struvite and calcium oxalate crystal formation — the most clinically complete urinary protection available in a single diet. Balanced Mineral Profile — Precisely controlled magnesium, calcium, phosphorus, and sodium levels — reducing the mineral concentrations that drive crystal formation without creating the imbalances that promote the opposite crystal type. Optimal Urine pH Targeting — Targets a urine pH range that is unfavorable for both struvite (alkaline) and calcium oxalate (acidic) crystal formation — the narrow pH window where both crystal types are minimized. High Moisture Encouragement — Formulated to encourage water intake and increase urine volume — diluting the mineral concentrations that drive crystal formation and reducing urine specific gravity. Struvite Dissolution Support — The formula supports the dissolution of existing struvite crystals and prevents new struvite formation — the most common crystal type in young to middle-aged cats. Calcium Oxalate Prevention — Prevents calcium oxalate crystal formation — the most common crystal type in older cats and the crystal type that cannot be dissolved by diet alone. Idiopathic Cystitis Support — Stress-reducing and anti-inflammatory nutritional support for cats with feline idiopathic cystitis (FIC) — the most common cause of FLUTD in young cats. High Palatability — Clinical urinary diets must be consumed consistently — the Virbac HPM formula is formulated for high palatability to ensure consistent daily consumption. Two Sizes — 400g trial size for initial introduction; 1.5kg for ongoing management. Virbac HPM — Veterinary Expertise — From one of the world's leading animal health companies. (Visual asset placement: flat-lay of both the 400g and 1.5kg Virbac HPM Urinary WIB bags, or lifestyle photo of a comfortable, healthy cat — communicating the urinary health and comfort the clinical diet supports.) Product Details & Features Understanding Feline Lower Urinary Tract Disease (FLUTD) FLUTD is an umbrella term for a group of conditions affecting the bladder and urethra of cats — and it is one of the most common reasons cats are presented to veterinarians. Understanding the spectrum of FLUTD conditions explains why the WIB formula's comprehensive approach is clinically superior to single-indication urinary diets: Prevalence: FLUTD affects approximately 1–3% of cats annually Recurrence rates are high — 30–50% of cats experience recurrence within 12 months without dietary management Male cats are at significantly higher risk of urethral obstruction — a life-threatening emergency The FLUTD spectrum: Feline idiopathic cystitis (FIC) — 55–65% of FLUTD cases: FIC is the most common cause of FLUTD in cats under 10 years — characterized by bladder inflammation without an identifiable cause. Stress is the primary trigger — environmental changes, multi-cat households, indoor confinement, and routine disruption all increase FIC risk. Clinical signs include straining to urinate, blood in urine, frequent urination of small amounts, and urinating outside the litter box. Struvite crystals/uroliths — 15–20% of FLUTD cases: Struvite (magnesium ammonium phosphate) crystals form in alkaline urine with high magnesium and phosphorus concentrations. They are the most common crystal type in young to middle-aged cats and can be dissolved by dietary acidification and mineral restriction. Calcium oxalate crystals/uroliths — 10–15% of FLUTD cases: Calcium oxalate crystals form in acidic urine with high calcium and oxalate concentrations.
