item.g:title: Revolution Topical Solution for Dogs, 20.1-40 lbs - 1 Pipette(Red Box)
item.g:description: Revolution is a medication that is applied directly on your furry friend's skin to protect them from biting critters. When applied every 30 days, Revolution protects against heartworms, fleas, and ear mites. It's also effective in preventing and treating roundworms and hookworms in kittens and sarcoptic mange and American dog tick infestations in puppies. Uses Revolution is formulated to kill adult fleas and prevents flea eggs from hatching for one month. It is also indicated for the prevention and control of flea infestations, prevention of heartworm disease caused by Dirofilaria immitis, and the treatment and control of ear mite infestations. Revolution is also indicated for the treatment and control of sarcoptic mange and for the control of tick infestations due to Dermacentor variabilis. Possible Side Effects In safety studies, Revolution was administered at 1, 3, 5, and 10 times the recommended dose to sixweek-old puppies, and no adverse reactions were observed. When tested for oral ingestion at the recommended topical dose in 5 to 8-month-old beagles, no adverse reactions were observed. In a topical safety study conducted with avermectinsensitive collies at 1, 3 and 5 times the recommended dose of Revolution, salivation was observed in all treatment groups. Revolution also was administered at 3 times the recommended dose to heartworm infected dogs, and no adverse effects were observed. If side effects do occur, please contact your veterinarian immediately. Drug & Food Interactions Talk to your veterinarian about any other drugs your dog is taking before starting this medication. Precautions Prior to administration of Revolution, dogs should be tested for existing heartworm infections. At the discretion of the veterinarian, infected dogs should be treated to remove adult heartworms. Revolution is not effective against adult D. immitis and, while the number of circulating microfilariae may decrease following treatment, Revolution is not effective for microfilariae clearance. Hypersensitivity reactions have not been observed in dogs with patent heartworm infections administered three times the recommended dose of Revolution. Higher doses were not tested. For use in animals only. Keep out of reach of children. " Made in USA " ( Zoetis )

item.g:title: Nunbell Round Pet Brush Large
item.g:description: Shape matters in grooming. A round pin pad isn't just a design choice — it's a functional one. The curved edge of the Nunbell Round Slicker Brush Large allows it to follow the natural contours of your pet's body more naturally than a flat rectangular pad, making it particularly effective for reaching the chest, legs, belly, and face without awkward angles or missed patches. The same fine wire pins. The same detangling, shedding-reduction, coat-smoothing performance. A shape that works with your pet's body, not against it. Available in Green, Pink, and Blue. ## Why the Nunbell Round Slicker Brush Large Is the Right Grooming Tool for Your Pet Round pin pad for contour-following grooming — The curved edge naturally follows the shape of your pet's body, maintaining consistent pin contact across rounded areas like the chest, shoulders, legs, and belly — areas where flat brushes often lose contact. Fine wire pins on a flexible pad — Densely packed, fine wire pins penetrate the coat to reach the undercoat, lifting loose hair, breaking up tangles, and smoothing the topcoat efficiently. Flexible pad design — The pin pad flexes to adapt to body contours, ensuring even pressure and effective grooming across every area of the coat. Removes loose hair and reduces shedding — Lifts dead, loose hair from both the topcoat and undercoat before it ends up on your furniture, clothing, and floors. Detangles knots and light matting — Effective on minor tangles and early-stage matting — work gently from the tips inward to avoid pulling. Leaves the coat smooth and finished — The fine pins smooth the coat after detangling, giving a clean, polished finish. Large format for thorough coverage — Despite the round shape, the large pad size ensures efficient coverage across the full body of medium and large pets. Three colors — Green, Pink, and Blue. Choose your preference or match your grooming kit. ## Round vs. Square — Which Should You Choose? Both the Nunbell Round and Square Slicker Brushes are large-format, fine-pin slicker brushes at the same price point. The difference is in the use case: Round Slicker Brush Square Slicker Brush Best for Contoured areas, cats, precise grooming Flat body areas, large breeds, speed Pad shape Round — follows body curves naturally Square — maximizes flat surface coverage Ideal for Chest, legs, belly, face, smaller pets Back, sides, full-body on large dogs Feel More precise, maneuverable Faster, broader coverage Many owners use both — the Square for the main body, the Round for finishing and detail work. ## Product Details & Features How It Works: The Nunbell Round Slicker Brush Large uses a round pad of fine, closely spaced wire pins to penetrate the coat and work through tangles, loose hair, and light matting. The round format allows the brush to be rotated and angled more freely during grooming, making it easier to work around the body's natural curves and reach areas that flat brushes struggle with. Best Used For: Cats of all coat lengths — the round format is particularly cat-friendly Medium and large dog breeds, especially for detail and finishing work Grooming curved body areas: chest, legs, belly, face, neck Pets who are sensitive to grooming — the round shape is often perceived as less intimidating Finishing pass after using a square or rectangular slicker brush How to Use: Start at the neck and work toward the tail in the direction of hair growth Use the round edge to follow body contours — rotate the brush as needed to maintain contact For tangles, work from the tip of the hair inward, gradually moving closer to the skin Use short, gentle strokes on sensitive areas (belly, legs, face) Remove collected hair from the brush pad after each section Reward your pet after grooming to build a positive association Grooming Frequency: Medium coats: 2–3 times per week Long or double coats: 3–5 times per week, or daily during heavy shedding

item.g:title: Perfecto Cat 10X Catsticks Mit Kalb & Truthahn 50g
item.g:description: Perfecto Cat — Catsticks Mit Kalb & Truthahn (Veal & Turkey) | 10 Sticks × 5g | 50g | Premium Cat Treat German precision. Premium proteins. Ten individual sticks. Perfecto Cat Catsticks Mit Kalb & Truthahn are premium German cat treat sticks made with veal and turkey — two of the most refined, lean, and palatable proteins available in the premium cat treat category. Each pack contains 10 individually portioned sticks of approximately 5g each — the perfect format for daily treating, training, and bonding, with the precise portion control that prevents overfeeding. Veal is the most tender, delicate expression of beef — lean, mild, and exceptionally digestible. Turkey is the leanest of the poultry proteins — rich in tryptophan, B vitamins, and the clean, mild flavor that cats find consistently appealing. Together, they create a dual-protein stick treat that is more nutritionally complete and more palatably interesting than single-protein alternatives — in the satisfying chewy stick format that cats love to hold, chew, and devour. German quality. Premium proteins. Ten sticks per pack. Why Perfecto Cat Catsticks Veal & Turkey Is The Best Choice Veal — The Most Tender Beef Protein — Veal is young beef — the most tender, delicate, and mildly flavored expression of beef protein, with exceptional digestibility and a refined flavor that cats find highly appealing. Turkey — The Leanest Poultry — Turkey is the leanest of the common poultry proteins — rich in tryptophan, B vitamins, and the clean, mild flavor that complements veal's delicate richness. Dual Premium Protein — Veal and turkey together provide a broader amino acid profile and more complete nutritional coverage than single-protein stick treats. 10 Individual Sticks — Pre-portioned into 10 individual sticks of ~5g each — perfect daily portion control, no measuring, no waste, no overfeeding. Stick Format — The elongated stick format that cats can hold between their paws and chew — engaging the natural holding and chewing behaviors that make stick treats one of the most satisfying treat formats. German Quality — Perfecto Cat — A trusted German pet food brand known for quality ingredients and precise formulation — the European quality standard applied to cat treats. Natural Taurine from Both Proteins — Both veal and turkey are natural taurine sources — the essential amino acid cats cannot synthesize. Chewy Texture — Satisfying chewing engagement that extends the treat experience and provides mild dental benefit. Novel Protein Variety — Veal is genuinely rare in cat treats — a novel protein that provides variety for cats who eat primarily chicken or seafood-based food. (Visual asset placement: lifestyle photo of a cat holding and chewing a Perfecto Cat stick, or flat-lay of the 10 sticks fanned out from the pack showing the individual portions.) Product Details & Features The Catstick Format — Why Sticks Work The cat stick format is one of the most engaging treat formats available — and it works because it aligns with natural feline feeding behaviors: Natural holding behavior: Cats in the wild hold prey with their front paws while eating — the stick format mimics this behavior, allowing cats to hold the stick between their paws and chew from one end. This holding and chewing behavior is deeply satisfying for cats — more engaging than simply eating a soft treat from a bowl. Chewing engagement: The firm, chewy texture of cat sticks requires sustained chewing — engaging the jaw muscles and providing a more physically satisfying treat experience than soft or liquid treats. Extended eating time: The chewing required for a stick treat extends the duration of the treat experience — cats spend more time engaged with the treat, increasing the perceived value and satisfaction. Mild dental benefit: The chewing action provides mild mechanical cleaning of tooth surfaces — a small but meaningful dental hygiene benefit. Portion clarity: Each stick is a clearly defined, individual portion — making it easy to control daily treat intake without measuring or estimating. Veal — The Most Refined Beef Protein Veal is the defining premium ingredient of this formula — and its inclusion reflects Perfecto Cat's commitment to quality over cost: What veal is: Veal is meat from young cattle — typically calves under 6 months of age. The youth of the animal produces meat that is: More tender — Less developed muscle fiber creates a softer, more delicate texture More mildly flavored — The flavor is more delicate and refined than mature beef — less gamey, less assertive, more palatable to cats with sensitive palates More digestible — The less developed muscle fiber and lower connective tissue content of veal makes it more easily digestible than mature beef Leaner — Veal is naturally leaner than mature beef — providing high-quality protein without excessive fat Nutritional profile of veal: Complete protein — All essential amino acids in proportions that closely match feline requirements Heme iron

item.g:title: IMac Dea Slow Food for Pet Blue / 0.45L (20*5 Cm)
item.g:description: IMac Dea Slow Food Feeder for Pets Fast eaters are a common problem — and a genuinely risky one. Dogs and cats who eat too quickly swallow excess air alongside their food, leading to bloating, vomiting, regurgitation, and in severe cases, the life-threatening condition known as gastric dilatation-volvulus (GDV) in dogs. The IMac Dea Slow Food Feeder is designed to solve this at the source: a beautifully designed Italian slow feeder bowl with a patterned interior that naturally slows eating pace, improves digestion, and turns every meal into a more mindful, healthier experience. Available in Blue and Red, in two sizes for cats and dogs of all breeds. item.g:title: Virbac Cortavance 76ml
item.g:description: Virbac Cortavance 76ml HYDROCORTISONE ACEPONATE TOPICAL SPRAY SOLUTION VETERINARY USE ONLY ■ DESCRIPTION: CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray is formulated with the active ingredient, hydrocortisone aceponate, 0.584 mg per mL in a suitable solvent, propylene glycol methyl ether for dermatologic use in dogs. Hydrocortisone aceponate is a dermocorticoid with a potent intrinsic glucocorticoid activity. ■ THERAPEUTIC CLASSIFICATION: Glucocorticoid ■ INDICATIONS: CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray is indicated for the symptomatic treatment of inflammatory and pruritic skin conditions in dogs. ■ DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION: Before administration, remove the cap and screw the pump spray on the bottle. The product is applied by activating the pump. Spray from a distance of about 10 cm above the area of skin to be treated. The recommended dose is 1.52 µg of hydrocortisone aceponate per cm2 of skin surface. This dose can be achieved with 2 pump spray activations over a 10 cm x 10 cm square surface area of skin. Leave treated area to dry. Presented as a volatile spray, this product does not require any massage. Care should be taken to avoid spraying in the eyes of the dog. Repeat treatment once daily for 7 consecutive days. If no improvement is seen within 7 days, treatment should be re-evaluated by the veterinarian. ■ CONTRAINDICATIONS: Do not use on cutaneous ulcers. ■ CAUTIONS: Total body surface treated with CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray should not exceed a surface corresponding to, for example, two flanks from the spine to mammary chains including the shoulders and thighs (1/3 of dog’s body). Avoid spraying in the eyes of the dog. In the case of concurrent microbial, fungal infections and flea infestations, dogs should receive appropriate treatment. If a favourable response does not occur promptly, treatment should be discontinued until the infection has been adequately controlled. Not for use in animals with hyperadrenocorticism (Cushing’s Disease). Since glucocorticoids are known to slow growth, use in young animals (under 7 months of age) is not recommended. Not for use in breeding, pregnant or lactating animals, as the safety of CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray has not been established. As with all glucocorticoids, the use of this product may adversely affect the Hypothalamic Pituitary Adrenal axis (HPA axis). Do not exceed the recommended dose or duration of treatment. Not for use in sick or debilitated animals. It is not recommended to apply other topical preparations simultaneously on the same lesion. ■ WARNINGS: Keep out of reach of children. In case of accidental contact with skin, it is recommended to wash thoroughly with water. Wash hands after use. Avoid contact with eyes. In case of accidental eye contact, rinse with abundant quantities of water. In case of eye irritation, seek medical advice. Avoid inhalation of CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray. In case of accidental ingestion, seek medical advice immediately and show the labelling to the physician. Spray in a well ventilated area. Flammable. Do not spray on naked flame or any incandescent material. ■ ADVERSE REACTIONS: Although not all adverse reactions are reported, the following adverse reaction information is based on voluntary post-approval drug experience reporting. It is generally recognized that this method of reporting results in significant under-reporting of adverse drug reactions. It should be noted that suspected ADRs listed here reflect reporting and not causality. Transient local reactions at the application site (erythema and/or pruritis) can occur in very rare cases (less than 1 in 10,000 animals). ■ CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY: Hydrocortisone aceponate belongs to the diester class of glucocorticoids. Diesters are lipophilic substances of low plasma availability that effectively penetrate the skin to accumulate at the site of inflammation without significant systemic absorption. Once inside the skin, the diesters are transformed to deliver anti-inflammatory activity. In laboratory animals, hydrocortisone aceponate is eliminated like endogenous cortisol, through the urine and faeces. ■ SAFETY AND EFFICACY STUDY INFORMATION: The safety of CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray in dogs was demonstrated in two studies using 1X, 3X and 5X the therapeutic dose for 14 consecutive days in young dogs. Dogs with 3X and 5X the recommended dose for twice the recommended duration of treatment resulted in a reduced capacity for production of cortisol that was reversible within 7 to 9 weeks after the end of treatment. No adverse effects were seen during the clinical studies. Clinical efficacy of CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray has been demonstrated in a multi-site, controlled clinical field trial in dogs under normal conditions of use. In this study, 105 dogs (54 dogs treated with CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray; 51 dogs as positive control) representing 33 breeds were diagnosed with the following skin dermatoses: Skin Dermatoses % Flea Allergy Dermatitis ……………………………………. 29% Acute Moist Dermatitis (hot spot)

item.g:description: VIRBAC Effitix Spot-On for Dogs Small (4–10 kg) Small breeds are just as vulnerable to fleas and ticks as larger dogs, but they require treatments precisely dosed for their size. VIRBAC Effitix Spot-On Small is formulated for dogs weighing between 4 and 10 kg, providing a correctly measured monthly topical treatment that protects without overexposure. The combination of permethrin and fipronil works on the skin and coat to kill fleas, ticks, and lice, and to repel biting insects. For small dogs that spend time in gardens, parks, or with other animals, monthly Effitix application builds a reliable protective barrier that lasts through an entire month. Effitix is particularly convenient for owners who find oral tablet administration challenging with smaller, less cooperative dogs. Product Features Designed for small dogs weighing 4 to 10 kg Monthly spot-on application for sustained parasite control Kills fleas, ticks, and lice on contact Repels biting flies and sand flies Dual-action formula: permethrin and fipronil Correctly dosed for small dog body weight Protection lasts up to 4 weeks Trusted VIRBAC veterinary product Active Ingredients Permethrin and Fipronil – dual-action ectoparasitic protection. How to Apply Part the fur to expose the skin at the back of the neck, between the shoulder blades. Apply the entire contents of the pipette directly to the skin. Avoid contact with the dog's eyes or mouth. Keep children away until the site is dry. Dosing Guide Dog Weight Variant Application Interval 4 - 10 kg Effitix Small Every 4 weeks Not for use on cats. Do not bathe the dog for at least 48 hours before or after application for maximum efficacy. Store in original packaging below 25°C. item.g:description: When you’ve got a newborn puppy, kitten or small animal who needs hand-feeding, the Bioline Pet Care Kit gives you the right tools — precise, safe and designed for little mouths and early growth stages. Why Bioline Pet Care Kit Is The Best Choice Specifically designed for emerging pets (puppies, kittens, rabbits, chinchillas, mink etc) who may not feed from standard bowls. Kit includes a 60 ml bottle, multiple nipples sized for small mouths and a bottle-brush—giving you a full, ready-to-use system. Durable plastics and pet-safe materials ensure that you can rely on this kit in critical early weeks of pet development. A practical, budget-friendly tool for owner-led care at home—hospital-level feeding support without the clinic price tag. Suitable for multiple small pet types—so one kit can serve different animals in your home. Product Details & Features This feeding kit is thoughtfully created for small animal care: Included Components: Bottle (60 ml capacity) Nipple tips (5 pieces) Bottle-cleaning brush 1 piece Material & Build: Durable plastic (bottle), soft nipple material and sturdy brush. Best For: Newborn or young puppies and kittens; small mammals (rabbits, chinchillas, mink) needing assisted feeding. Special Features: Small-mouth nipple design making it easier for tiny animals to latch. Additional nipples provide sizing flexibility as the pet grows. Bottle brush included so hygiene and cleaning are built into the kit—important for safe feeding. Usage Scenarios: Hand-feeding orphaned or weak puppies/kittens until they transition to bowl feeding. Supplementing feeding for small-pet species who cannot use standard feeding bottles. Travel or emergency kit for breeders or pet-owners who may need to feed away from home. Specifications & Use Feature Detail Bottle Capacity 60 ml Included Nipples 5 pcs Included Brush 1 pcs bottle-brush Suitable For Puppies, kittens, rabbits, chinchillas, mink etc Material Durable plastic bottle, soft nipple, cleaning brush How to use: Assemble the bottle with the appropriate nipple for your pet’s size. Fill with appropriate formula or milk substitute at correct temperature. Position pet comfortably; gently guide the nipple to the pet’s mouth. Feed careful small amounts and pause if the pet shows signs of distress or over-feeding. After each feeding, clean the bottle, nipple and brush thoroughly to maintain hygiene. Store all components in a clean, dry place ready for next use.

item.g:title: Automatic Dog & Cat Water Fountain with Water Level Indicator
item.g:description: Make fresh drinking water more accessible for your pet with this Automatic Pet Water Fountain , an electric drinking fountain designed for cats and small dogs. Featuring a flowing waterfall-style spout, a wide drinking tray, and a visible water level window, this fountain keeps water circulating and provides a convenient drinking station for everyday use. Key Features & Benefits Continuous Water Circulation: Electric pump circulates water through the fountain while operating. Waterfall-Style Flow: Features a raised spout that pours water into the drinking tray. Wide Drinking Area: Offers an accessible surface for cats and small dogs to drink comfortably. Water Level Indicator: Front viewing window makes it easier to monitor the remaining water. Electric Operation: Includes a wired pump component for powered water circulation. Compact Design: Suitable for placement in a convenient indoor pet feeding area. Modern Grey Finish: Features a dark grey body with a metallic-look upper rim. Flowing Water for Everyday Hydration Some cats prefer drinking from moving water rather than a stationary bowl. The Automatic Pet Water Fountain creates a flowing water stream that may encourage pets attracted to running water to drink more frequently. Its wide drinking tray allows your pet to access circulating water without needing to drink directly from the waterfall. Water circulation does not guarantee improved hydration, so always monitor your pet's daily water intake. Waterfall-Style Drinking Design The fountain features a raised water outlet that directs water into the upper drinking tray. The electric pump circulates water through the system while connected to a suitable power supply. This design provides moving water in an accessible drinking area, making it a practical alternative to a conventional water bowl. Convenient Water Level Monitoring A vertical viewing window on the front of the fountain allows you to check the water level without opening the entire unit. Regularly monitoring the water level helps ensure the pump has sufficient water for operation. Always follow the manufacturer's minimum and maximum filling instructions. How to Use Wash the removable water-contact components before first use. Assemble the fountain and pump according to the manufacturer's instructions. Fill the reservoir with clean drinking water to the recommended level. Connect the pump to a compatible power supply. Check that water circulates correctly through the outlet. Place the fountain on a stable, level indoor surface. Refill with fresh water regularly and clean the reservoir, drinking tray, and pump as directed. Disconnect the power before cleaning or handling the pump. Never operate the pump without sufficient water. item.g:title: IMac Diva Single Bowl for Pet Red / 2.8L (30.5*9.8 Cm)
item.g:description: IMac Diva Bowl for Pets The most versatile bowl in the IMac range. The Diva Bowl brings Italian design sensibility to a classic, upright bowl format — available in four sizes that span the full range from small cats and toy breeds to large and giant breed dogs, and in two bold colors that make it as much a design statement as a feeding solution. Clean lines, a taller profile, and the same commitment to quality that defines every IMac product — the Diva is the bowl for owners who want the right size, the right color, and the right aesthetic, all in one. Why IMac Diva Bowl Is the Best Choice Four sizes for every pet — from 0.40L for small cats and toy breeds to 2.8L for large and giant breed dogs, the Diva range covers the complete spectrum of pet sizes in a single, consistent design language Available in Blue and Red — two bold, distinct color options that allow personalization, aesthetic matching to your home, or easy visual differentiation between bowls in multi-pet households Taller, upright bowl profile — the Diva's more cylindrical form is particularly well-suited to pets who prefer a deeper bowl, and to longer-eared breeds where a taller, narrower bowl keeps ears out of the food Italian IMac design — the clean, considered aesthetic that IMac is known for, applied to a classic bowl format that works in any home environment Smooth interior surfaces — no corners or crevices where food residue can accumulate; easy to clean thoroughly after every use Stable base design — proportioned to stay in place during feeding without tipping or sliding Suitable for both cats and dogs — a single product line that works across species at every size Product Details & Features The Diva Bowl occupies a distinct position in the IMac lineup. Where the Ciottoli is defined by its flat, pebble-inspired form and the Dea by its rounded, low-profile design, the Diva brings a taller, more upright bowl profile that serves a different set of practical needs. The taller form is particularly valuable for certain breeds and feeding situations. Long-eared dogs — Cocker Spaniels, Basset Hounds, Beagles — benefit significantly from a taller, narrower bowl that keeps their ears elevated above the food surface, reducing the mess and hygiene issues that come with ears dragging through wet food. Cats who prefer to eat without their whiskers touching the bowl sides — a common sensitivity known as whisker fatigue — may also find the Diva's proportions more comfortable than very wide, shallow bowls. The four-size range is the most comprehensive in the IMac bowl lineup, making the Diva the natural choice for households with multiple pets of significantly different sizes, or for owners who want a single bowl design that can scale with a growing puppy from small to large. The two color options — Blue and Red — add a dimension of personalization that makes the Diva stand out in the IMac range. Whether you're matching a color scheme, differentiating between a food bowl and a water bowl, or simply choosing the color your cat or dog seems to prefer, the Diva gives you that choice without compromising on quality or design. Key Features: Italian IMac design — clean, upright bowl aesthetic Available in Blue and Red 4 sizes: 0.40L, 0.9L, 1.9L, 2.8L Taller, more cylindrical profile — ideal for long-eared breeds and whisker-sensitive cats Smooth interior surfaces — easy to clean Stable base — anti-tip design Suitable for cats and dogs of all sizes

item.g:title: Nunbell Cat Toy Roll Around Flutter Bug Orange
item.g:description: It rolls. It flutters. It's completely irresistible. The Nunbell Roll Around Flutter Bug is a dual-action cat toy that combines an unpredictably rolling ball base with a fluttering bug attachment — triggering your cat's ground-chase and aerial-pounce instincts at the same time. The result is a toy that holds attention longer, encourages more active play, and delivers the kind of multi-sensory stimulation that keeps cats genuinely engaged. Available in Blue and Orange. Why the Nunbell Roll Around Flutter Bug Is the Best Choice Dual-Action Play — Rolling ball base + fluttering bug attachment = two hunting triggers in one toy Unpredictable Movement — The rolling motion mimics erratic prey behavior, keeping cats alert and engaged Fluttering Bug Element — The aerial flutter component invites swatting, pouncing, and batting — natural predatory behaviors cats need to express Sustained Engagement — Multi-sensory stimulation holds attention far longer than single-action toys Encourages Independent Play — Keeps cats active and entertained without requiring your constant involvement Trusted Nunbell Brand — Consistent quality and durability from a recognized pet care name Available in Blue & Orange — Two bold, high-visibility colors that cats can track easily during play Product Details & Features The Roll Around Flutter Bug is engineered around how cats actually hunt. In the wild, cats don't just chase — they stalk, swipe, pounce, and bat at prey that moves unpredictably across multiple planes. This toy replicates that experience: the rolling ball base moves across the floor in erratic, prey-like patterns while the fluttering bug attachment moves through the air above it, creating a layered play experience that engages your cat's full hunting sequence. This kind of multi-stimulus play is particularly valuable for indoor cats, who don't have access to the natural hunting opportunities that outdoor cats experience. Regular active play sessions reduce boredom, prevent stress-related behaviors, and support healthy weight and muscle tone. The Nunbell build quality ensures the toy holds up through enthusiastic daily play sessions without the bug attachment detaching or the rolling mechanism losing its responsiveness. Key Features: Rolling ball base — unpredictable, prey-like ground movement Fluttering bug attachment — aerial stimulus for swatting and pouncing Dual-action design — engages ground-chase and aerial-hunt instincts simultaneously Sustained engagement — multi-sensory play holds attention longer Encourages independent, self-directed play Suitable for kittens and adult cats Durable Nunbell construction — built for daily active play Available in Blue and Orange Specifications Detail Info Brand Nunbell Toy Type Roll Around Flutter Bug Play Elements Rolling ball base + fluttering bug attachment Available Colors Blue, Orange Suitable For Kittens & Adult Cats Best For Independent play, active stimulation, indoor cats

Designed for dogs weighing between 10 and 20 kg, this beef-flavored chewable tablet is readily accepted by most dogs. Fluralaner, the active ingredient, is absorbed into the bloodstream and kills parasites on contact when they bite, without needing to be pre-positioned on the coat. Bravecto is especially useful in Egypt's warm climate, where fleas and ticks remain active year-round. Three-month dosing means fewer missed treatments and more consistent protection for your dog. Dosing Guide Dog Weight Tablet Strength Dosing Interval 10 - 20 kg Bravecto 500 mg Every 12 weeks Give with or just after a meal. Do not use in dogs under 8 weeks of age or weighing less than 10 kg. item.g:title: Nunbell Dog & Cat Nail Clipper with Non-Slip Handle - Black & Green
item.g:description: Keep your pet's nails neatly trimmed with the Nunbell Pet Nail Clipper , a practical grooming tool designed for dogs and cats. Featuring a curved metal cutting blade, spring-assisted handles, and a non-slip grip, this nail clipper provides better control during routine nail trimming at home. Key Features & Benefits Precise Nail Cutting: Curved metal blades designed for trimming pet nails. For Dogs & Cats: Suitable for pets whose nail size is compatible with the clipper. Non-Slip Comfort Handle: Black and green grips help provide a secure hold during use. Spring-Assisted Design: The visible spring helps reopen the handles between cuts. Controlled Trimming: Handheld design allows you to trim nails gradually. Everyday Grooming Essential: A practical tool for maintaining your pet's nails between professional grooming appointments. Comfortable & Controlled Nail Trimming Regular nail trimming helps prevent nails from becoming excessively long, which can affect your pet's comfort when walking or moving. The Nunbell Pet Nail Clipper features a curved cutting edge designed to trim pet nails, while its shaped handles provide a comfortable grip. Its spring-assisted mechanism helps make repeated trimming movements more convenient. Designed for Dogs & Cats The clipper is presented on the packaging for both dogs and cats. It can be used as part of a regular grooming routine, provided the clipper size is appropriate for your pet's nails. The exact recommended breed sizes and nail thickness are not specified on the visible packaging. How to Use Choose a calm, well-lit area where your pet feels comfortable. Gently hold your pet's paw and identify the nail tip. Locate the quick, the sensitive area inside the nail containing blood vessels and nerves. Trim only a small amount from the nail tip, avoiding the quick. Repeat gradually, allowing breaks if your pet becomes uncomfortable. Clean the clipper after use and store it in a dry place. For dark nails, trim in very small increments because the quick may be difficult to see. If you're unsure how much to cut, ask a veterinarian or professional groomer for guidance. item.g:description: Keep your pet's coat neat, smooth, and well-groomed with the Nunbell Double-Sided Pet Grooming Brush , a practical 2-in-1 grooming tool designed for dogs and cats. Featuring a metal pin brush on one side and a dense bristle brush on the other, it helps remove loose hair, work through minor tangles, and maintain your pet's coat during regular brushing sessions. Key Features & Benefits 2-in-1 Grooming Design: Combines a metal pin brush and a bristle brush in one convenient tool. Metal Pin Side: Helps loosen minor tangles and collect loose hair from the coat. Bristle Side: Helps smooth the outer coat and remove loose surface hair. Rounded Pin Tips: The visible rounded ends are designed for gentler contact during brushing. For Dogs & Cats: Suitable for pets with compatible coat types. Easy-Grip Handle: Provides comfortable control during everyday grooming. Regular Coat Maintenance: Helps keep your pet's coat tidy between grooming appointments. Two Brushes in One Metal Pin Brush The metal pin side features spaced pins with rounded tips. It can help work through loose hair and minor tangles while grooming the coat. Use gentle strokes without pressing the pins into your pet's skin. Bristle Brush The opposite side features densely arranged bristles designed to smooth the coat and collect loose surface hair. It's a practical finishing step after using the pin side. Everyday Grooming for Dogs & Cats Regular brushing helps maintain a manageable coat and gives you an opportunity to check for tangles, loose fur, or changes in your pet's skin. The Nunbell Double-Sided Grooming Brush provides two brushing options in one tool, allowing you to adjust your grooming routine to your pet's coat and comfort. It can be used as part of regular at-home grooming between baths and professional grooming sessions. How to Use Make sure your pet's coat is dry and free from severe matting. Start with the metal pin side to gently work through loose hair and minor tangles. Brush in the direction of hair growth using light, controlled strokes. Turn the brush over and use the bristle side to smooth the outer coat. Remove collected hair and clean the brush after use. Avoid brushing over wounds, irritated skin, or painful tangles. item.g:title: For Vet Medical Fipro Care Spray 125 ml
item.g:description: For Vet Medical Fipro Care Spray 125 ml each 1 ml contains: Fipronil....................... 0.28% Mixture of antiparasitic phytochemical extracts. INDICATIONS: Effective for treatment & prevention of all life stages of ectoparasites, tick, flea and lice in Dogs & cats. DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION: Ruffle the animal's coat while applying spray mist to its body. >Hold the bottle in upright position and spray 10-20 cm above the body and against hair direction. >Apply on entire body concentrating on affected area. » Allow animal to air dry in well tventilated area (Do not towel dry). RESIDUAL ACTION: Ticks: 1 month (3-5 week). Fleas: 2 months (1-3 months) this will depend on the parasite challenge in the animal's environment. STORAGE: Store below 30° C in dark place. Protect from heat. item.g:title: Royal Canin Hypoallergenic dogs 2KG
item.g:description: Royal Canin Hypoallergenic Dogs is a scientifically formulated veterinary diet designed for dogs with food allergies and intolerances. This therapeutic nutrition features hydrolyzed protein to minimize allergic reactions while providing complete and balanced nutrition for dogs with severe dietary sensitivities. Key Features: Veterinary diet for dogs with food allergies Hydrolyzed protein formula Supports skin and digestive health Reduces adverse food reactions Scientifically proven formula by Royal Canin experts Complete and balanced therapeutic nutrition Nutritional Benefits: Hydrolyzed Protein: Protein source broken down into low molecular weight peptides (less than 3.5 kDa) to reduce the risk of allergic reactions Skin Barrier: Exclusive complex of nutrients (EPA, DHA, biotin, niacin) reinforces the skin's barrier role and supports skin health Digestive Security: Highly digestible ingredients and prebiotics support optimal digestion and intestinal health Omega-3 Fatty Acids: EPA and DHA help modulate inflammatory responses and support overall health Antioxidant Complex: Synergistic antioxidants help neutralize free radicals Feeding Instructions: Consult your veterinarian before use. Serve dry or slightly moistened. Daily amounts vary by weight and activity: 5kg: 95g, 10kg: 160g, 15kg: 215g, 25kg: 315g, 35kg: 405g. Divide into 2 meals daily. Recommended feeding period: 3-8 weeks for elimination trial, up to lifetime for food allergy management. Always provide fresh water. Official Royal Canin Partner in Egypt: PetYard is proud to be an official partner of Royal Canin in Egypt, ensuring you receive 100% authentic Royal Canin products with guaranteed quality and freshness. Fast delivery available to Cairo, Giza, Alexandria, and all major cities across Egypt.

item.g:title: Royal Canin Urinary SO Gravy - Canine (100 gm\ Pouch) – Wet food for urinary tract disease – 12 pouches per box 1 Pouch
item.g:description: **PLEASE CONSULT YOUR VET BEFORE PURCHASING** Key Features/Benefits: Struvite dissolution Low RSS Urine dilution Royal Canin Urinary S/O Canine gravy effectively dissolves struvite uroliths. Undersaturated urine is an environment where crystals cannot proliferate. Thus the urine is unfavourable to the development of struvite and calcium oxalate crystals. Diluting urine decreases the urinary concentration of struvites and calcium oxalates. The larger urinary volume also ensures regular bladder wash-out. Composition: Meat and animal derivatives, cereals, oils and fats, vegetable protein extracts, derivatives of vegetable origin, minerals, various sugars Additives (per KG): Nutritional additives: Vitamin D3: 210 IU, E1 (Iron): 3.5 mg, E2 (Iodine): 0.25 mg, E4 (Copper): 2 mg, E5 (Manganese): 1.1 mg, E6 (Zinc): 11 mg, Urine acidifying substances: calcium sulfate: 0.25%. Technological additives: (acidity regulator) Sodium bisulfate: 1.107 g. *NOTE: Values reflect only levels added to the formula, not those naturally occurring in components of the diet. For total levels in the diet, refer to the Average Analysis pages Royal Canin Urinary S\O Gravy is RECOMMENDED FOR: Struvite uroliths: dissolution and management of recurrence Calcium oxalate uroliths: management of recurrence Bacterial cystitis: management of secondary struvite crystalluria Royal Canin Urinary S\O Gravy is NOT RECOMMENDED IN CASE OF: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) Heart disease Concurrent use of urine-acidifying drugs Growth, gestation/lactation Disclaimer: The product images have been prepared for information purposes only, and are designed to enhance your shopping experience on the website, it is not a substitute for you reading the product packaging and label prior to use. You should note that products and their ingredients are subject to change. item.g:title: Nunbell Pet Nail Clipper Small / green
item.g:description: Nunbell Pet Nail Clipper Groom with confidence. This large-size nail clipper is specially designed for larger dogs or pets with thicker nails—delivering clean, safe cuts and making nail care easier for both you and your pet. Why Nunbell Pet Nail Clipper – Size Large Is The Best Choice Precision stainless-steel blades deliver clean cuts without splintering—ideal for larger nails. Ergonomic, non-slip handle ensures secure control, even when clipping strong or moving paws. Built-in safety guard/stop helps prevent over-cutting and protects the quick. Designed for dogs (and pets) with thicker nails or large sizes—a trustworthy grooming tool. Excellent value: when you have a big pet, this “large” version means fewer trips to the groomer and more at-home control. Product Details & Features This clipper is built for durability, safety and ease-of-use in homes with bigger pets: Blade material: High-grade stainless steel for sharp, reliable performance. Handle & grips: Ergonomic form with non-slip surface to handle strong paws and active pets. Safety features: A built-in stop or guard to prevent cutting too close; lock mechanism for safe storage. Size application: Large variant—built for large-breed dogs, thick nails, or multi-pet households where bigger tools matter. Usage scenarios: Home-grooming of large dogs to reduce over grown nails or “clicking” on floors. Pet owners comfortable doing grooming themselves and wanting a reliable home tool. Regular maintenance tool that supports healthier, more comfortable paws for big dogs. Specifications & Use Feature Detail Variant Size Large Blade Material Stainless steel Handle Type Ergonomic, non-slip grip Safety Guard/Stop Yes Suitable For Large dogs, pets with thick nails, multi-pet households Suggested Use Frequency Every 2–4 weeks (or as nails grow, depending on pet) How to use: Choose the “Size Large” variant to match your dog’s size and nail thickness. Calm your dog and hold its paw gently—identify the nail to be trimmed and avoid the quick (the coloured part inside the nail). With the clipper positioned correctly, make a smooth, confident cut—avoid crushing or jagged edges. If unsure how much to trim, err on the side of less—cut too little rather than too much. Clean the clipper blades after use, lock it for safe storage, and check the blades for dullness or damage before the next session.

item.g:title: Virbac Cat Urology Dissolution& Prevention 1.5Kg
item.g:description: Virbac HPM — Cat Urology Dissolution & Prevention | 1.5kg | Veterinary Clinical Dry Cat Food Dissolve existing struvite. Prevent recurrence. Virbac HPM Cat Urology Dissolution & Prevention is a veterinary clinical nutrition dry cat food specifically formulated for the active dissolution of struvite crystals and uroliths, and the long-term prevention of struvite recurrence. Where the Virbac HPM Urinary WIB formula provides balanced dual protection against both struvite and calcium oxalate crystals, the Dissolution & Prevention formula is a struvite-targeted clinical diet — more aggressively formulated for urine acidification and mineral restriction to actively dissolve existing struvite deposits and prevent new struvite formation. This is the formula prescribed when struvite crystals have been confirmed by urinalysis or imaging — the clinical diet that works actively to resolve the existing crystal burden while simultaneously preventing recurrence. Struvite is the most common urinary crystal type in cats — and dietary dissolution is the preferred first-line treatment for struvite uroliths, avoiding the need for surgical removal in most cases. 1.5kg — the struvite dissolution and prevention diet that resolves the problem and keeps it resolved. Why Virbac HPM Cat Urology Dissolution & Prevention Is The Best Choice Active Struvite Dissolution — Formulated to actively dissolve existing struvite crystals and uroliths through urine acidification and mineral restriction — the dietary alternative to surgical urolith removal. Struvite Prevention — Maintains the urinary environment that prevents new struvite crystal formation after dissolution is complete — for long-term recurrence prevention. Urine Acidification — Targets a urine pH that dissolves struvite (which requires alkaline conditions to form and acidic conditions to dissolve) — the primary mechanism of dietary struvite dissolution. Magnesium & Phosphorus Restriction — Struvite is composed of magnesium ammonium phosphate — restricting these minerals reduces the substrate available for crystal formation. High Moisture Encouragement — Increasing urine volume dilutes mineral concentrations and flushes the urinary tract — supporting both dissolution and prevention. Struvite-Confirmed Indication — The appropriate choice when struvite crystals have been confirmed by veterinary urinalysis or imaging — more targeted than the WIB formula for confirmed struvite cases. Dissolution Without Surgery — Dietary struvite dissolution avoids the need for surgical cystotomy in most cases — a significant benefit for cat owners and cats alike. High Palatability — Clinical urinary diets must be consumed consistently for dissolution to occur — the Virbac HPM formula is formulated for high palatability. Virbac HPM — Veterinary Expertise — From one of the world's leading animal health companies. 1.5kg — The ongoing management size for the dissolution and prevention program. (Visual asset placement: flat-lay of the Virbac HPM Dissolution & Prevention bag with the clinical branding prominent, or lifestyle photo of a comfortable, healthy cat — communicating the urinary health the clinical diet restores.) Product Details & Features Struvite — The Most Common Feline Urinary Crystal Struvite (magnesium ammonium phosphate, MgNH₄PO₄·6H₂O) is the most common urinary crystal type in cats — accounting for approximately 40–50% of feline uroliths submitted for analysis. Understanding struvite formation and dissolution explains why the Dissolution & Prevention formula works: How struvite forms: Struvite crystals form when urine contains: Alkaline pH (>7.0) — Struvite is insoluble in alkaline urine and precipitates readily High magnesium concentration — Magnesium is a structural component of struvite High ammonium concentration — Ammonium (from protein metabolism) is a structural component of struvite High phosphate concentration — Phosphate is a structural component of struvite Concentrated urine — High urine specific gravity increases the concentration of all crystal-forming minerals Risk factors for struvite formation: Urinary tract infection (UTI) — Urease-producing bacteria alkalinize urine and increase ammonium — the most common cause of struvite in dogs (less common in cats) Alkaline diet — High-carbohydrate, plant-protein-heavy diets tend to alkalinize urine Concentrated urine — Inadequate water intake Female cats — Wider urethra allows bacteria to ascend more easily (UTI-associated struvite) How struvite dissolves: Struvite is soluble in acidic urine — reducing urine pH below 6.5 causes existing struvite crystals to dissolve. This is the mechanism of dietary struvite dissolution: The Dissolution & Prevention diet acidifies urine to pH 6.0–6.5 Existing struvite crystals dissolve in the acidic urine Dissolved minerals are excreted in the urine The crystal burden is progressively reduced over 4–12 weeks The diet is continued to prevent recurrence The Dissolution & Prevention Formula — Clinical

VETERINARY HPM® Adult Small & Toy Dog also includes psyllium fibre and bentonite to regulate the digestive system and ensure normal stool odour and consistency. Virbac HPM Dog Hypoallergy With Hydrolysed Fish Protein is a veterinary clinical nutrition dry dog food formulated using hydrolysed fish protein — the most scientifically validated approach to eliminating food allergy reactions in dogs. Hydrolysis is the process of breaking protein molecules into fragments so small that the immune system can no longer recognize and react to them — eliminating the allergenic trigger at the molecular level rather than simply avoiding common allergens. This is not a "grain-free" or "limited ingredient" commercial food — it is a genuine clinical hypoallergenic diet, developed by Virbac's veterinary nutritionists and validated through clinical research, for dogs with confirmed or suspected food allergies and food intolerances. Fish as the Hydrolysed Protein Source — Fish is selected as the hydrolysis substrate for its high digestibility, complete amino acid profile, and status as a novel protein for most dogs who have been fed chicken or beef-based diets. Elimination Diet Standard — Suitable for use as the elimination diet in food allergy diagnosis protocols — the clinical standard for identifying food allergy triggers. Product Details & Features Understanding Canine Food Allergy — The Problem This Diet Solves Food allergy in dogs is an immune-mediated adverse reaction to one or more dietary proteins — the immune system incorrectly identifies a food protein as a threat and mounts an inflammatory response. item.g:title: Virbac EPIOTIC for Dog & Cat SIS 125ML VBI
item.g:description: The veterinary standard for ear hygiene. Virbac Epiotic is the world's most widely used veterinary ear cleaning solution — a clinically proven, non-irritating ear cleaner specifically formulated to clean, dry, deodorize, and maintain the healthy ear environment of dogs and cats. Epiotic is not a treatment for ear infections — it is the preventive and maintenance ear cleaner that removes the wax, debris, and moisture that create the conditions for otitis externa (ear infection) to develop. Regular ear cleaning with Epiotic is the single most effective preventive measure for otitis externa — the most common ear condition in dogs and one of the most frequent reasons for veterinary consultation. Epiotic's unique formulation combines salicylic acid (ceruminolytic — dissolves ear wax), a monosaccharide solution (creates an osmotic environment that draws moisture from the ear canal), and EDTA-Tris (antimicrobial potentiator) — working together to clean the ear canal, reduce moisture, acidify the ear environment, and create conditions unfavorable for bacterial and yeast growth. Gentle enough for regular weekly use. Effective enough to be the ear cleaner that veterinary dermatologists recommend worldwide. 125ml — the ear hygiene solution that prevents the problem before it starts. Why Virbac Epiotic Is The Best Choice The World's Most Widely Used Veterinary Ear Cleaner — Epiotic is the ear cleaning solution that veterinary dermatologists recommend and prescribe more than any other — the clinical gold standard for ear hygiene in dogs and cats. Ceruminolytic Action — Salicylic acid dissolves and loosens ear wax (cerumen) — allowing it to be flushed out of the ear canal rather than accumulating and creating a substrate for infection. Drying Effect — The monosaccharide solution creates an osmotic environment that draws moisture from the ear canal — reducing the humidity that bacteria and yeast require to thrive. Acidifying Effect — Epiotic acidifies the ear canal environment — creating a pH that is unfavorable for the growth of the bacteria and yeast most commonly responsible for otitis externa. EDTA-Tris — Antimicrobial Potentiator — Enhances the antimicrobial effect of the acidified environment — disrupting bacterial cell walls and increasing susceptibility to the ear's natural defenses. Non-Irritating — Gentle enough for regular weekly use — does not irritate the sensitive skin of the ear canal even with frequent application. Deodorizing — Removes the organic debris and microbial metabolites that produce the characteristic unpleasant odor of dirty or infected ears. Otitis Prevention — Regular use prevents the wax accumulation, moisture retention, and pH shift that create the conditions for otitis externa to develop. For Dogs & Cats — Formulated for use in both species — a versatile veterinary ear cleaner for multi-pet households. Virbac — Veterinary Expertise — From one of the world's leading animal health companies. 125ml — A practical size for regular maintenance ear cleaning. (Visual asset placement: lifestyle photo of a dog or cat having its ears cleaned with Epiotic — communicating the ease and gentleness of the cleaning process — or flat-lay of the Epiotic bottle with the clinical branding prominent.) Product Details & Features Understanding Otitis Externa — The Problem Epiotic Prevents Otitis externa (inflammation and infection of the external ear canal) is one of the most common conditions in dogs — accounting for approximately 10–20% of all veterinary consultations. Understanding how otitis develops explains why regular ear cleaning with Epiotic is the most effective preventive measure: The ear canal environment: The canine and feline ear canal is L-shaped — with a vertical canal and a horizontal canal leading to the eardrum. This anatomy: Traps moisture, wax, and debris — particularly in dogs with floppy ears or narrow canals Creates a warm, dark, humid environment — ideal for bacterial and yeast growth Makes self-cleaning difficult — the dog cannot effectively remove accumulated debris The otitis development cascade: Predisposing factors — Floppy ears, narrow canals, excessive hair in the canal, swimming, allergies, or hormonal disorders create conditions that favor otitis Primary factors — Allergies (the most common), foreign bodies, parasites (ear mites), or keratinization disorders initiate the inflammatory process Secondary factors — Bacteria ( Staphylococcus , Pseudomonas ) and yeast ( Malassezia ) colonize the inflamed ear canal — converting inflammation into infection Perpetuating factors — Chronic changes to the ear canal (thickening, stenosis, calcification) make the condition self-perpetuating Where Epiotic intervenes: Epiotic intervenes at the earliest stage — removing the wax, debris, and moisture that create the conditions for the otitis cascade to begin. item.g:title: Nunbell Pet Flea Comb Clean & Tidy
item.g:description: Nunbell Pet Flea Comb Clean & Tidy Protect your pet from fleas and ticks with the Nunbell Pet Flea Comb Clean & Tidy. This essential grooming tool features ultra-fine teeth specifically designed to catch and remove fleas, flea eggs, ticks, and debris from your pet's coat. Safe, chemical-free, and effective, this flea comb is a must-have for any pet owner committed to keeping their furry friend comfortable and pest-free. Why Nunbell Pet Flea Comb Is The Best Choice Fine-Tooth Design : Ultra-close teeth spacing effectively traps fleas, flea eggs, and ticks Chemical-Free Solution : Safe, natural flea removal without harsh chemicals or pesticides Early Detection : Helps you spot flea infestations before they become serious problems Gentle & Safe : Smooth, rounded teeth won't scratch or irritate your pet's skin Multi-Purpose : Also removes dirt, debris, and loose fur while checking for parasites Product Details & Features At petfast.shop, we understand that fleas and ticks are more than just a nuisance—they can cause serious health issues for your pet and infest your home. The Nunbell Pet Flea Comb provides a safe, effective way to detect and remove these parasites without exposing your pet to chemicals. The ultra-fine teeth are precisely spaced to catch even the smallest fleas and their eggs, making this an essential tool for flea prevention and control. Key Features: Ultra-fine, closely-spaced metal teeth Smooth, rounded tips prevent skin irritation Ergonomic handle for comfortable grip Durable stainless steel or high-quality metal construction Suitable for dogs and cats of all sizes Works on all coat types and lengths Easy to clean between uses Lightweight and easy to maneuver Chemical-free, safe for puppies and kittens Essential for flea monitoring and removal Usage Guide & Flea Detection Suitable For: Dogs and cats of all sizes and coat types Ideal For: Flea detection, flea removal, tick removal, parasite monitoring How to Use: Prepare Your Pet : Ensure your pet is calm and comfortable Start at the Head : Begin combing from the head, working toward the tail Comb Thoroughly : Work through the entire coat in small sections, paying special attention to warm areas where fleas congregate Check the Comb : After each stroke, examine the comb for fleas, flea dirt, or eggs Dip in Water : Keep a bowl of soapy water nearby to dip the comb and drown captured fleas Focus on Hot Spots : Pay extra attention to neck, ears, armpits, groin, and base of tail Repeat Regularly : Use daily during infestations, weekly for prevention Key Areas to Check: Fleas prefer warm, protected areas on your pet's body: Around the neck and collar area Behind and inside the ears Under the front legs (armpits) Groin and belly area Base of the tail and lower back Between the toes Identifying Flea Infestation: What to Look For: Live Fleas : Small, dark brown insects that move quickly Flea Dirt : Black specks (flea feces) that turn red when wet Flea Eggs : Tiny white or translucent oval specks Excessive Scratching : Your pet scratching more than usual Red, Irritated Skin : Flea bites cause inflammation Hair Loss : From excessive scratching and biting Flea Dirt Test: Place suspected flea dirt on a white paper towel and add a drop of water. If it turns reddish-brown, it's flea feces (digested blood). Flea Control Best Practices: Regular Combing Schedule: During Infestation : Daily combing until fleas are eliminated Prevention : 2-3 times per week during flea season Year-Round Monitoring : Weekly checks even in winter Complete Flea Control Program: Treat Your Pet : Use flea comb plus veterinarian-recommended flea treatment Treat Your Home : Vacuum thoroughly, wash bedding, treat carpets and furniture Treat Outdoor Areas : Address yard and outdoor spaces where your pet spends time Prevent Re-Infestation : Maintain regular combing and preventive treatments Care & Maintenance: Clean the comb after each use Remove trapped fleas and debris Wash with hot, soapy water Disinfect regularly with pet-safe cleaner Dry thoroughly before storing Store in a clean, dry location Replace if teeth become bent or damaged DB34968

item.g:title: Nunbell Dog & Cat Nursing Bottle with Cleaning Brush
item.g:description: Make bottle feeding young pets more convenient with the Nunbell Pet Nursing Bottle , a practical feeding set designed for puppies and kittens that need assisted milk feeding. The set includes a plastic nursing bottle, two feeding nipples, and a cleaning brush to help you prepare, offer, and clean up after feeding. Key Features & Benefits Designed for Young Pets: A nursing bottle intended for assisted feeding of puppies and kittens. Two Feeding Nipples: Includes one nipple fitted to the bottle and an additional spare nipple. Bottle Cleaning Brush: Helps clean the inside of the bottle between feeding sessions. Plastic Bottle: Lightweight and convenient to handle during feeding. Practical Feeding Set: Combines essential bottle-feeding accessories in one package. Easy Everyday Care: Suitable for use with an appropriate puppy or kitten milk replacer, following veterinary guidance. What's Included? 1 × Nunbell Pet Nursing Bottle 2 × Feeding Nipples 1 × Bottle Cleaning Brush Assisted Feeding for Puppies & Kittens Newborn or young puppies and kittens may need bottle feeding when they cannot nurse normally or require additional nutritional support. The Nunbell Nursing Bottle provides a practical way to offer an appropriate milk replacer while following a feeding schedule recommended by your veterinarian. The correct milk type, quantity, and feeding frequency depend on your pet's age, weight, and condition. How to Use Clean the bottle and accessories before the first use. Prepare a species-appropriate puppy or kitten milk replacer according to its instructions. Check that the milk is at a suitable feeding temperature. Make sure the nipple opening allows an appropriate flow. Hold your puppy or kitten in a natural, belly-down feeding position. Allow the animal to suckle gently without squeezing milk forcefully into its mouth. Clean and dry all components thoroughly after feeding. Important: Incorrect bottle feeding can cause choking or aspiration. Seek veterinary guidance when feeding newborn, weak, orphaned, or unwell animals.
